apps.name: Switchlings
apps.description:
Switchlings is a Sokoban-inspired puzzle game. Every Switchling carries one arrow above its head. Pick a Switchling and tap it to make it step in its direction. Walk it into another to trade arrows. Bring every Switchling home, and the board is clear.

That trade is the heart of every puzzle. Who needs which arrow, who has to hand theirs over, and in what order? Each of the 300 levels needs at least one real trade, so every solution ends in a small “aha” instead of a lucky tap.

TEN WORLDS, EACH WITH ITS OWN TWISTS
• Sunny Garden: springs, currents, portals, buttons that open gates, and crates to push.
• Happy Farm: linked Switchlings who move together, sleepers to wake, and signposts.
• Toy Box: bump switches, swap pads and turntables.
• Bug Woods: ledges you can only hop down, and screens that slide when you bump a lever.
• Coral Reef: homes that drift away, and Switchlings without an arrow.
• Cozy Kitchen: ice that sends you sliding.
• Flooded Ruins: arrow banks, steps to climb, and platforms you raise and lower.
• Glass Garden: arrow banks that turn the other way, and light pillars only one colour can pass.
• Starry Sky: cracked tiles that crumble behind you, and thresholds that seal shut.
• Cloud Castle: keys and locked gates.
Every world mixes its new ideas with the ones before, and closes with five hard levels.

BUILD YOUR OWN
• With the full game, make levels in the Level Designer from every piece you’ve met, then share them with friends as a code or a link.
• Play the levels your friends share.
• Share a picture or a video of any solution.
• Every Switchling, mechanic and world you meet joins your Collection.

CALM BY DESIGN
• Undo and restart as often as you like.
• A hint keeps the moves you got right, rewinds only the ones that went astray, and shows who moves next.
• No stars, timers, lives or move counters. Progress is simply levels cleared.
• Painted worlds and an original soundtrack, with a theme for every world.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, with progress synced through iCloud.
• Touch, keyboard, Siri Remote or game controller.
• Upright or sideways on iPhone and iPad.
• Plays offline.
• 18 Game Center achievements.
• A Switchlings sticker pack for Messages.
• Available in 19 languages.
• Share the full game with your family through Family Sharing.

apps.name: Riftshock: Neon Space Shooter
apps.description:
A neon twin-stick arena shooter for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases, no energy. Eight modes, Game Center Challenges, full controller support, 120 fps.

Fly with one thumb and aim with the other: floating sticks start wherever your thumbs land. Kills and close calls charge two specials. Throw the Rift to tear open space and drag the swarm toward it. Hold the Surge to gather everything near you into a pressure field.

EIGHT MODES
• Endless: sixteen kinds of enemy, a mini-boss every five waves and a boss every twenty. How deep can you go?
• Expedition: choose a ship and build it as you fly, three cards at a time. Beat the boss at wave 40 to win the run, then climb the Depth ladder.
• Rodeo: no gun. Your ship leaves a line behind it; close a loop around the crowd and everything inside is gone.
• Fault Lines: no gun, one hit. Thread a fault line and it blows, taking everything that was chasing you.
• Haven: safe ground that does not stay safe. Hold it while it lasts, then run for the next.
• Blitz: the same four minutes for everyone, in step with the music.
• Hardcore: Endless, with nothing to spare.
• Daily Rift: a new arena and a new pair of twists every day, and one ranked try.

GAME CENTER
A leaderboard for every mode, 23 achievements, and Challenges you can send to a friend from the game-over screen.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Touch, or a controller with every menu included and buttons you can remap. On Mac, aim with the mouse. On Apple TV, play with a controller.

ITS OWN SOUNDTRACK
A synth track for every mode and a theme for every boss.

Pay once and the whole game is yours: no ads, no in-app purchases, no energy, nothing to unlock with money.

apps.name: Kometa: Gravity Flight
apps.description:
Hold your finger down and a planet pulls your comet in. Let go and the comet flies straight. That is the whole control scheme. The rest is up to you.

Kometa is a free one-finger arcade game about flying through endless space. Swing around planets, collect stars and skim past surfaces to push your multiplier up to ×9. Just don't circle for too long: the dark is rising from below.

ENDLESS FLIGHT
Space is built anew on every flight and never repeats. Each sector is faster and denser, with orbiting moons, rock swarms and giant planets.

DAILY SKY
The same sky for every player in the world. Three tries a day. Share your result and see which friend flew furthest.

CLEAR FROM THE FIRST SECOND
A dotted line always shows where the comet goes if you switch, and turns red when a crash is ahead. The tutorial takes one planet.

TAILS
Unlock eight comet tails by reaching far sectors, collecting stars and keeping daily streaks. Your tail appears on the picture you share.

HONESTLY FREE
No ads, no purchases, no sign-up. Works offline. The game collects no data.

apps.name: Merry Arrow
apps.description:
Welcome to a tiny theater where every direction is part of the show. The arrows do not sit still. You swipe them, hold them, and cue them, and the stage answers.

Merry Arrow is not a menu of reading. Each act is a short performance you play with your hands.

ARROW ORCHESTRA — THE CONDUCTOR'S STAND
Four arrow musicians share one stage. Swipe the matching direction on beat. Flick the fast notes, hold the long ones, and press two pads together when a chord arrives. The window is the music. Miss the beat and the phrase drops. Later performances add mirrored hands, tighter timing, and phrases you have to remember.

CHEER WAVE — THE SEATING BOWL
The crowd is a fan of sections, each with its own arrow. Swipe across an arrow to stand that section, and along it to sit them down. Some rows only join a wave that reaches them. Match the small preview before you run out of actions. A cleared pattern can be played again as a stricter Encore.

CONFETTI CUE — THE FINALE PRESS
Colored shells drift in toward marked zones. Press the cue the current rule asks for, right as a shell arrives. The rule can flip: follow the arrow, answer with its opposite, or turn it clockwise. Two buttons at once fire a diagonal. Land the burst inside the circle and the pattern fills in.

A COMPLETE FESTIVAL
• 78 levels, thirty in Arrow Orchestra and twenty-four in each of the other acts, all free and retryable.
• Three Festival Specials, one for each act, with a harder Encore remix on every level you have cleared.
• Three stars on every level, from a clear to a precise performance.
• Three assists on each level. They widen a phrase, preview a wave, or reveal the next cues.
• Thirteen posters on the festival wall, each with a real unlock condition.
• A daily festival note, plus arrow costumes, finger trails, and a practice room for swipe and rhythm.
• High-contrast arrows, a visual beat flash, and calmer decorations when you want a quieter stage.

apps.name: Lexicoggle
apps.description:
An excellent vocabulary might just save a very peculiar little life.
Meet the Coggles: small creatures with impeccable hats and questionable survival instincts. In Lexicoggle, your words become their way out. Solve crossword-style clues, arrange the letter blocks, and build a connected escape route through a wonderfully strange world.
Every expedition brings six predicaments. Every answer brings your unlikely adventurers one step closer to safety.
WORDS THAT BUILD THE WAY
Turn answers into bridge decks, ladder rungs, slide sections, tunnel supports, and bomb locks. Watch the Coggles walk, climb, duck, and slide through the route you create.
THREE CURIOUS WORLDS
Explore The Cloudreach, The Underbloom, and The Sundrift. Discover storybook landscapes with changing routes, scenery, and obstacles across your expeditions.
A LITTLE PERIL. OR A LITTLE PEACE.
Race a shared clock as ledges crumble and fuses burn. Correct answers buy precious time. Prefer a gentler adventure? Take the scenic route and enjoy the rescue without a timer.
THINK A FEW STEPS AHEAD
Explore the course and tackle obstacles in your own order. Unfinished answers and completed structures stay in place as you move between clues. Need a nudge? Use a letter hint, shuffle the blocks, or try a different word.
KEEP NOTES FROM THE PECULIAR
Collect solved words in your personal word cabinet and track your rescues and best streak. Return to your discoveries whenever curiosity strikes.
Your next expedition is waiting. The Coggles would tip their hats, but they’re rather busy being in trouble.

apps.name: MathMenace
apps.description:
A crossword puzzle for math equations. Equations are hidden in a grid, running across, down and diagonally, forwards or backwards. Only the numbers show: the +, −, × and ÷ are left out, so 3, 4, 12 is 3 × 4 = 12, and 18, 12, 6 is 18 − 12 = 6. Drag across the numbers to find each one. A number can belong to more than one equation, so a grayed-out number may still be part of one you have not found.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY One daily puzzle, the same for everyone, always free. Easy early in the week, Hard on Fridays and Saturdays. Finish it each day to build a streak.

YOU PICK THE SIZE Choose a grid from 4 × 4 up to 12 × 12. Small grids are a quick coffee-break puzzle; the big ones take real concentration. Grids up to 6 × 6 are free.

ADD, SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE Every equation uses one of the four operations. Some run four numbers long, like 26, 2, 14, 10: those are worth more.

RACE THE CLOCK Find every equation to finish the puzzle. A timer and a score track how you did, and a new puzzle is always one tap away.

THREE LEVELS AND FOUR THEMES Easy is just adding and taking away. Normal is the classic game. Hard has lines of up to six numbers, mixed operators that follow the order of operations (2 + 3 × 4 = 14), squares and roots, and numbers hidden behind a ? that you work out from the equations around it. Four themes add twists: Times tables, Big sums, Long chains, and Squares and roots.

POINTS THAT SHOW HOW HARD Your time is what is ranked; points are the second number. A harder equation is worth more, and there are bonuses for combos, speed and a puzzle with no hints and no wrong tries. A rules page in the app shows exactly how each point is earned.

TIMED AND TARGET Find as many equations as you can in 2 minutes, or race to a points target.

FREE, WITH ONE UNLOCK The game is free: Easy and Normal, grids up to 6 × 6, a hint in every puzzle, Give up, the daily puzzle at every level, the scoring rules, saved games and Light and Dark. One purchase unlocks the full game, for good: grids up to 12 × 12, the Hard level and four themes, Timed and Target modes, unlimited hints, Top Scores and four more color palettes. No ads, no subscription.

TOP SCORES (FULL GAME) Every puzzle you finish is timed and scored. See your ten fastest for each grid size with their points and dates, sort by any column, and try to beat them.

YOUR COLORS Indigo and Graphite are free; the full game adds Ocean, Sunset, Forest and Berry. Every palette has a light and a dark version. Choose Light, Dark, or follow your phone, so the game looks the way you like it.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF Your game is saved as you play. Leave, switch apps or close it, and it is right where you left it, even the clock.

SHARE AND CHALLENGE Share your time, or a puzzle code that plays the exact same grid on a friend's phone. No accounts: it goes through your phone's own share sheet.

LEARN IN A MINUTE A short hands-on practice grid teaches the one idea, and numbers can be used in more than one equation.

STATISTICS Puzzles finished, your streaks, and your best and average time at every grid size.

YOURS, OFFLINE No ads. No account. No internet needed.

apps.name: AXIOM: Math Crossword
apps.description:
A math crossword where every answer is an equation.

Read across, read down. Each run of cells has to make the number in the
chip at its end. Place the tiles, make every line true, and the board is
solved.

TEN CHAPTERS, 660 BOARDS
Start with plus and minus on a small grid. Meet multiplication on its
own, then division on its own, then both in the same line. Learn why the
order of operations matters, go below zero, and open the board out into
a real crossword with walls. Each chapter teaches exactly one new idea.

  Carry — plus and minus, nothing below zero
  Tables — multiplication alone, until it is reflex
  Sharing — division, and only the divisions that come out exactly
  Crossword — walls open the board out, entries start to cross
  Times & Into — multiply and divide together
  Precedence — all four, and the ORDER is the puzzle
  Below Zero — negative cells and negative targets
  Tall — boards shaped like your phone
  Wide — a 6x6 crossword, far more of it
  Mastery — everything at once, and it keeps getting harder

CLIMB — A PUZZLE TRACK WITH NO TOP
When the chapters run out, Climb does not. The difficulty keeps rising
step after step, for as long as you keep solving.

ONE BOARD A DAY
Everybody gets the same daily crossword. Keep the streak going.

EVERY BOARD IS FAIR
No board is ever a guess. Each one is checked before you see it: there
is exactly one way to finish it, and it can always be reasoned out from
what is already on the grid.

MADE ON YOUR PHONE
Boards are generated on the device, so the app works on a plane, on the
underground, and anywhere with no signal. Nothing is uploaded. There are
no accounts and nothing to sign in to.

NO ENERGY, NO TIMERS, NO COIN PACKS
Play as long as you like. There is one optional purchase that unlocks
everything, and one advert you can choose to watch for an extra life.
That is all.

BUILT TO BE READ
Nine themes, bigger numbers, left-handed tray, shapes as well as colour,
and a calmer background if movement is distracting.

Privacy policy: https://pingee.app/axiom/privacy-policy.html

apps.name: Color Slide: Swipe Puzzle
apps.description:
A puzzle where you can see the future: for every swipe direction, the tray shows exactly where the next balls will drop in.

Swipe and every ball on the tray slides that way. Get 4 of one color touching and they pop. Nothing merges, nothing doubles: just line up colors and clear them.
After every move, new balls enter from the wall opposite your swipe. The little balls around the rim are the preview: "swipe this way and this color lands here."

THREE THINGS TO THINK ABOUT
1. Read the preview: pick the direction where an incoming ball completes a match, and it pops the moment it lands
2. Build chains: balls keep sliding after a pop, so set up the second and third match in advance
3. Save your power balls: pop 5 at once for a BOMB, 6 or more for a LINE. They wait on the tray until you tap them, so keep them for a tight spot

OBSTACLES AND HELPERS
Gray stones that never pop. Rainbow balls that match any color. Undo, swap the next ball, or smash up to 4 balls with the hammer.

EASY TO PICK UP
Close the app any time and continue later. A short tutorial guides your first moves. Game Center leaderboards for best score and longest chain. Japanese and English.

8 BALL SKINS
Smiley, Animals, Fruit, Jewels, Donuts, Stars, Ghosts and Planets. Unlock them with your best score (Ghosts and Planets are premium).

PRICING
Free to play (ads and in-app purchases). Each game uses 1 stamina; 1 comes back every 15 minutes (max 5), or watch an ad to refill.
The Color Pass is a 1-month auto-renewing subscription (7-day free trial for new members): unlimited play, no ads between games, undo/swap/hammer without ads, and every skin. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or current period. Manage it in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://harypary.github.io/irosoroe/privacy.html

apps.name: Glacier Rush 3D
apps.description:
Grab your snow tube and race down glaciers, icy half-pipes and aurora-lit peaks!

Glacier Rush 3D is a fast, physics-driven downhill racer. Carve up the walls of frozen half-pipes, launch off kickers, flip and spin in the air, and stick the landing for a burst of speed. Three rivals are chasing the same finish line. Out-ride them all to take first place.

RACE THREE STUNNING WORLDS
• Glacier Pass: blue ice, deep snow and towering pines
• Sunset Ridge: golden light over windswept slopes
• Aurora Peaks: a glowing night run under the northern lights

PULL OFF BIG TRICKS
• Swipe in the air to backflip, frontflip and spin
• Land clean for a speed boost
• Hit glowing boost pads and grab coins on every run

COLLECT RIDERS AND TUBES
• Kit the Arctic Fox, Bjorn the Polar Bear Cub, Nova the Snow Hare and Pepper the Husky Pup
• Every rider handles differently. Find your favorite!
• Unlock tube skins from Frostbite to Neon with the coins you earn

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Simple one-finger controls: drag to steer
• No energy timers and no waiting. Race as much as you like
• No ads
• Plays offline

Glacier Rush 3D is free to play. Optional in-app purchases include coin packs, a one-time Starter Pack and a permanent Coin Doubler.

Questions or feedback? Write to support@kineticbit.io

apps.name: AntClub Ant Farm Simulator
apps.description:
Your room. Your ant farms. A thousand tiny stories.

Build and care for your own ant colonies in a 3D room. Start with a queen, prepare her home and watch your colony grow.

BUILD THEIR HOME
Combine nest modules, arrange your tables and personalize your space as you progress.

CARE FOR A LIVING COLONY
Provide food and water, keep the nest clean and observe eggs, larvae, pupae and workers. Each species has its own needs.

DISCOVER REAL ANTS
Unlock real species and learn about their diets, castes and lives in the species guide.

GROW YOUR LITTLE WORLD
Grow supplies, expand your house and open a colony shop. Time keeps moving while the game is closed.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No account required. Saves stay on your device, and the app works offline.

AntClub is played in landscape orientation.

FREE DOWNLOAD AND ONE-TIME UNLOCK
Play free through keeper level 9. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks progression from level 10 onward. You can continue caring for your existing colonies without purchasing. No subscriptions. Beta players retain their already-earned level and unlocks; the full game lets them keep levelling up.

apps.name: Cumulark
apps.description:
Cumulark turns the theory of cross-country gliding into a turn-based puzzle. You have a glider with no engine, a top-down map of an invented valley and a task: round the turnpoints in order and come back over the airfield before the sun goes down.

A move is one kilometre to a neighbouring cell, flown at Float, Glide or Run. Faster saves time and costs height; slower keeps height and loses time. Every key on the control pad shows how high above the ground you will be after that move, so each choice is a trade you can see. Under a cumulus cloud you can circle: each turn gains height until you reach cloudbase.

The air is part of the puzzle:
- thermals under the clouds, drawn thicker while they are strong and fading through the afternoon;
- ridges that lift the air on the side the wind comes from, with sinking air behind them;
- patches of sink you will want to cross quickly, or not at all;
- wind that speeds you up on one leg and holds you back on the next.

Drop below 150 metres above the ground and the glider lands in a field. Finish over home from 100 metres and you are done.

The 72 tasks are spread over six fictional regions. They begin with a short loop in still air and grow into long triangles in a crosswind, with a ridge, a lee and thermals dying towards evening. The weather in each task is fixed and shown in full on the map and in the briefing, so every flight can be planned and replayed.

Each task has a reference time, the shortest one a complete search of every possible move found. It stays hidden until you finish. Within 5 percent of it earns three stars, within 20 percent two.

Coins come from flying: first finishes, three-star finishes and the first finished task of each day. They pay for a glide cone that shades where you can reach without climbing, for the next three moves of the reference flight, and for glider liveries and a night map. Coins never unlock tasks.

Free: regions 1 and 2 (24 tasks), daily coins, hints and liveries.
Pro, a single purchase: regions 3 to 6 (48 tasks), a barogram of each flight drawn over the reference, CSV export of the logbook, and a watercolour map.

Soaring Notes explains the glider polar, MacCready speed, thermals and ridge lift in plain words, with the same numbers the game uses.

The valleys, airfields and weather are invented. Cumulark is a game; it does not use your location and is not a flight-planning or weather tool. It works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking.

apps.name: Typing Games: GhostType
apps.description:
Type faster. Restore the signal.

GhostType turns typing practice into a game. Enjoy a quick practice session or follow your Journey, taking on challenges that help you build speed, accuracy, and confidence.

FOLLOW YOUR JOURNEY
Explore chapters, complete missions, and help reconnect a city to restore its signal. Work toward new goals, revisit challenges, and see how far your typing can take you.

MAKE PRACTICE FEEL LIKE PLAY
Put your typing skills to the test with a variety of games and challenges. Stay focused, find your rhythm, and keep improving with every session.

PRACTICE YOUR WAY
Fit practice into your day with flexible sessions and custom text. Whether you have a few minutes or want a longer challenge, build your skills at your own pace.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Track words per minute (WPM), accuracy, session history, and personal records. Review your results, celebrate improvements, and set your next goal.

PLAY OFFLINE
Enjoy gameplay and keep your progress on your device without an app account. Use the native onscreen keyboard or a connected hardware keyboard, and adjust sounds, haptic feedback, and cursor settings to suit your style.

OPTIONAL LIFETIME PURCHASE
GhostType offers an optional one-time lifetime purchase. No subscription. An internet connection is required to purchase or restore access.

Privacy Policy: https://luchv.com/ghosttype/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apps.name: MDAS Squares
apps.description:
Four numbers. One target. Combine two tiles at a time with +, −, × or ÷ until one number is left. If it matches the target, you've solved it. Every step has to land on a whole number, so no fractions and no shortcuts. Every puzzle is checked to have an answer that uses all four numbers.

DRAG OR TAP
Drag one tile onto another and pick the operation with a flick: right for +, left for −, up for ×, down for ÷. Or just tap a tile, an operator and a second tile. Undo takes back any step.

FIVE SETS, 100 TARGETS
Start with targets 1–20. Solve 100 different puzzles in a set to open the next one, all the way up to 81–100. Want one number? Custom deals puzzles for a single exact target.

DAILY
Ten new puzzles every day, the same for everyone. One clock covers the whole set. Compare your time on the Today and All time Game Center leaderboards.

CHALLENGES
• Time trial: solve against the clock in any set you've opened.
• Race: ten puzzles that get harder from first to last.
• Checklist: find up to ten different results in a set.
• Variable: one number is hidden as x. Build the expression, then solve for x.

MULTIPLAYER
Play a friend in real time through Game Center. Quick match and Invite: first to solve each puzzle scores a point, and the first to 10 points wins. Race is ten shared puzzles, and the first to solve all ten wins.

AND MORE
• Hints in untimed Play show one move that still reaches the target
• 20 Game Center achievements, including a gold badge for completing each set
• Relaxing music and piano chords that build with every combine (Music and Sound toggle separately)

Challenges and Multiplayer are included with Full Game, a one-time in-app purchase that also removes ads. Play and Daily are open to everyone.

Questions or ideas? Use Send Feedback in Options or write to feedback@morellcreations.com.

Privacy policy: https://morellcreations.com/privacy/mdas-squares/

apps.name: Giants Riot
apps.description:
Take giant monsters on an arcade rampage around the world!

Climb buildings, smash city blocks, battle the defenses and chase new scores across ten cities. Discover new monsters, earn medals and save your progress on your device. Includes English and Portuguese interfaces and touch controls.

Play Rio de Janeiro for free. The one-time Full Campaign in-app purchase unlocks access to the remaining nine cities in progression order. No subscription. Restore previous purchases with the same Apple Account.

apps.name: Battle Blocks
apps.description:
Shoot. Block. Outlast.

Battle Blocks is a neon arcade game where you break enemy formations, drop defensive blockers, and grab power-ups as the arena closes in.

Play offline in Solo Battle, same-phone Versus, or Arcade Ladder. Take on shifting formations and bosses in Survival, play Daily Survival, or jump straight into a boss fight you’ve unlocked in Boss Practice. In Block Hunt, pass the phone and take turns revealing and destroying hidden blocks.

Go online for ranked Quick Match with weekly and all-time leaderboards. Invite a friend to an unranked best-of-three series and choose your arena and house rules.

All game modes are free. The optional Cosmetic Theme Pack unlocks Deep Space and Pixel Cabinet.

apps.name: BrawlerOne
apps.description:
BrawlerOne is a party brawler starring wobbly, floppy stick figures who fight with fists and whatever they can grab.
Knock everyone off the stage to win — if you can keep your own noodle legs under control!

■ Simple controls, total chaos
• Four buttons: Punch, Kick, Jump and Grab
• Punch three times for an uppercut; kick in the air for a drop kick
• Grab rivals to drag them around or toss them off the edge
• Pick up bats, hammers and pillows to swing or throw
• Knocked out? Mash the buttons to get back up faster

■ 13 wild stages
Rooftop, rope bridge, spinning disc, boxing ring, icy sea, trampolines, seesaw, factory, pendulum castle, crumbling floor, construction site, pirate ship and the moon — packed with sweepers, presses, cannons and more.

■ Play together
• Solo play against CPUs (three difficulty levels)
• Nearby battles for 2–4 players (friends can join with the free version)
• Online battles for 2–4 players via Game Center
• Not enough players? CPUs fill the empty spots

■ Dress up
Mix 16 colors, 18 hats and 9 faces to make your own fighter.

■ Free version and Full Version
The free version includes CPU battles on 4 stages and joining a nearby friend's room.
A one-time "Full Version" purchase unlocks all 13 stages, online battles, hosting rooms and dress-up.
No ads.

apps.name: SkyRuins
apps.description:
Plan the escape order before the floor disappears. SkyRuins is a strategy and logic puzzle for teenage and adult players: every explorer slides together, and each escape changes the board. Sliding statues and cracked pillars add new constraints as you climb.

An ancient tower above the clouds has woken up — and it is falling apart. Lead five explorers up, one floor at a time, to the Heart of Light at the top.

Tilt the board and every explorer slides until a wall or another explorer stops them. Each time someone escapes through the door, an outer edge of the floor crumbles away, so the order you bring them out matters.

• 6 floors, 60 hand-picked levels — featuring sliding statues and cracked pillars that hold only once
• Today's Ruin — a fresh puzzle every day, with a streak to keep
• 2P Duel — face each other over one device and race on different boards
• A storybook tale that continues as you clear each floor
• Unlimited Undo and one free hint on every level
• Core puzzles play offline; progress is saved on your device

Remove Ads (one-time purchase): no full-screen ads between levels, plus hints and skips without ads. Restore anytime in Settings. Skip eligibility and the three-per-floor limit still apply.

apps.name: Off Course: 3D Golf
apps.description:
Real golf courses. Rebuilt in 3D. Played with a swipe.

Off Course rebuilds real U.S. golf courses hole by hole from public lidar scans, aerial photos and OpenStreetMap. Every slope comes from real elevation data, and the fairways, greens, bunkers, water and trees are placed from maps and photos of the actual course. Then it hands you the club.

No made-up layouts. No launch monitor or headset. Just real courses, on your phone.

Off Course #1 is free to play. One purchase unlocks every other course, and courses added in future updates are included.

SWING IT YOUR WAY
• Pull down, flick up and watch it fly
• Angle the flick to shape a fade or a draw
• Lay up with a mark: lift the view over the hole and tap where you want the ball, and the club and plays-like follow
• Every shot is simulated: launch, spin, wind, bounce and roll
• Read the green, then pull back and let go to putt

GOLF THAT FIGHTS BACK
• Wind that moves the ball, from calm to breezy
• Or choose Live for the forecast wind at the course right now, from the National Weather Service
• Plays-like yardage that accounts for the wind and the climb or drop to the pin
• Water that swallows your ball with a splash
• Trees that play like trees: clip the edge and you might sneak through; hit the heart of one and you probably won't
• Red lines and stakes mark water, white marks out of bounds

SEE THE WHOLE HOLE
• Fly over the hole from wherever your ball sits
• Lost the flag behind a hill? Tap the flag button for a beacon over the hole
• Watch any shot again, in slow motion if you like
• Play upright, or turn it sideways on iPhone and iPad
• Choose your tees and keep score hole by hole

HEAR THE COURSE
• Birdsong to suit each course, the splash of water and the strike of every shot
• The wind you hear follows the wind you play
• Choose wind and birds, wind only or no background sound

EVERY COURSE HAS ITS OWN LOOK
• Desert scrub, Florida palms, mountain views, lakes, a bayside course and a trip to Hawaii
• Each locked course opens with a short tour, then its first hole is yours to play free

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Every course is built into the app, so you can play without a signal (Live wind, and buying or restoring the unlock, need a connection)
• No ads. No account. No data collected.

The fine print: Off Course isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any golf club, so courses appear by number and nearby town. Public map data can be incomplete, so a hole may not match the real course exactly. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Elevation: USGS 3DEP. Aerial imagery: USDA NAIP. Live wind: National Weather Service forecasts.

apps.name: Puttle
apps.description:
Swipe to hit the ball. It rolls in a straight line until something stops it: a tree, a bunker, the edge of the course. Sink it in as few strokes as you can.

Every hole is a small puzzle with a best answer. Find the shortest line for an eagle and three stars, or take the long way round and still finish. Restart any hole, any time.

THE DAILY PUTTLE
Three new holes every day, the same for everyone in the world. One try at each. Afterwards, see the eagle line, keep your streak going and share your round with friends.

12 COURSES, 216 HOLES
• Meadows: trees, bunkers, water and out of bounds
• Dunes: seaside links where the wind moves your ball
• Lakeside: lily pads, bridges, tunnels, a drawbridge and geese
• Canyon: slopes, gopher holes, river currents and loose boulders
• Glacier: snowbanks and thin ice
• Resort: sprinklers, golf carts and one-way hedge gates
• Maple Ridge: leaf piles and deer crossings
• Highlands: fog, sheep and wind
• Stadium: island greens, a mower and the crowd
• Night: play by lamplight
• Volcano Isle: lava and steam vents
• Boardwalk: seaside mini golf with windmills

SIMPLE AND FAIR
• Meadows and the Daily Puttle are free. Get three stars on every Meadows hole to earn Dunes.
• One purchase unlocks every course, your rank on the Daily Puttle leaderboard and among your Game Center friends, the past Daily Puttles you missed, and every course added later.
• No ads, no subscription, and no hints, coins or lives for sale.
• Family Sharing supported.
• No account needed.


Unlock all courses is a one-time purchase. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. It is not a subscription: it never renews and there are no further charges. The purchase is linked to your Apple ID and can be restored on any of your devices with Restore Purchase in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://pattammaro.com/puttle/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://pattammaro.com/puttle/privacy-policy

apps.name: Don't say it! Party Game
apps.description:
Get your friends together, grab one phone and start describing. The catch? Some words are forbidden.

Don't say it! is the word-guessing party game for friends, families and game nights. Describe the word on the card so your team guesses it before time runs out, without ever saying the forbidden words listed below it. Slip up and you lose a point.

HOW TO PLAY
• Split into teams and pass the phone around
• Describe the word, avoid the forbidden ones
• Correct guess: +1 point. Forbidden word: −1. Stuck? Skip it
• The team with the most points at the end wins

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic: 2 to 4 teams take turns describing, round after round
• Everyone for themselves: 3 to 5 players. One describes, everyone else races to guess first

BONUS ROUNDS
Every now and then the rules change and every guessed word is worth double:
• Mime only: no words, just gestures
• Rhyme time: no forbidden words, but every sentence must rhyme
• Whistle it: whistle the song, your team guesses the title

4,500 CARDS, 15 CATEGORIES
Food, Cinema, Music, Animals, Sport, Superheroes, Video Games, TV Series, Art, Science, Tech, Travel, Cartoons, Jobs and Literature. 300 cards per category, from easy to hard.

YOUR RULES
Pick the timer, the number of rounds, the difficulty, the categories and which bonus rounds can show up.

FIVE LANGUAGES
Play in English, Italian, French, Spanish or German.

FREE TO PLAY
Food, Cinema, Music and Animals are free. Remove ads and unlock more categories with a one-time purchase, no subscriptions:
• No Ads: play without ads
• Premium: no ads + Sport, Superheroes, Video Games and TV Series
• Ultimate: no ads + every category, including future ones
Or buy only the categories you want.

apps.name: 조선해왕
apps.description:
조선해왕은 1550년 부산포에서 시작하는 항해·교역·해전 게임입니다.

3년 전 해금을 어기고 먼 바다로 나간 뒤 소식이 끊긴 아버지. 남은 것은 낡은 조운선 한 척과 약간의 빚뿐입니다. 부산포 면포를 사서 대마도에 팔며 첫 항해를 시작하세요.

■ 사서, 건너서, 비싸게 판다
항구마다 산지와 수요지가 다릅니다. 인삼·면포·비단·은·후추 등 교역품 20종의 시세를 장부에 모으고, 계절풍과 식량·물을 따져 이익이 남는 뱃길을 찾으세요.

■ 살아 있는 바다
조선·일본·명·류큐, 남만의 배까지 60여 함대가 저마다의 뱃길을 오갑니다. 안개 덮인 바다를 직접 밝히며 항구 20곳과 숨은 발견물 41곳을 찾아보세요.

■ 판옥선 선단과 해전
조운선에서 판옥선·세키부네·캐러벨까지. 최대 5척 선단을 꾸려 왜구와 맞서고, 배 옆구리를 적에게 돌려 일제 사격을 퍼부으세요. 검은 물길 깊은 곳에는 크라켄이 기다립니다.

■ 동료와 명성
선비, 셈쟁이, 요리사… 동료 다섯을 모아 6인 일행을 완성하세요. 교역·모험·해적, 어느 길로 가도 명성이 쌓입니다.

■ 한 번 구매로 전부
광고도 추가 결제도 없습니다. 모든 바다와 1장 이야기 끝까지 즐길 수 있습니다.

apps.name: ARCANODE: Rune Circuit Puzzle
apps.description:
Connect it. Light it up.

On the night of the Great Stoppage, every lamp in the magic-circuit city of Arca went dark, and Master Gram vanished.
All he left behind was an unfinished grimoire. Apprentice circuit mage Lino and Pico, a small brass robot, begin their training from its very first page.

■ Place runes. Wire them up.
Place runes on the board and connect them with wires to build a spell. Add, compare, choose, repeat: 23 kinds of runes.
Cast it, and mana flows down the wires one beat at a time. Pico walks, and the street lamps light up.
Get the expected answer on every test, and the request is complete.

■ 131 requests: 13 chapters + 4 extra chapters
Lamp keepers, a floodgate keeper, a clock keeper, a money-changer, a librarian, a factory boss. Take on the townsfolk's requests and learn new techniques one at a time.
Compare and let through, route the flow, loop, remember, change behavior by state, respond to events.
Get a hands-on feel for how programs think, without writing a single line of code.

■ Lots to master
• 3 stars: clear without notes (hints) / within the rune target / on the first try
• Beat Medal: reach the answer in fewer beats
• 4 extra chapters: Repair, Guess, Counterexample, Tidy

■ For players who
• love a puzzle with real bite
• are curious about programming or circuits
• enjoy pixel-art towns and characters

■ Also
• 日本語 / English / 한국어 / 简体中文 / 繁體中文
• No ads, no in-app purchases
• Plays fully offline. Progress is saved on this device.

apps.name: Boardroom FC: Football 2027
apps.description:
You're the chairman. Start at the bottom of seven divisions and take your club all the way to the top.

Boardroom FC is a football club management game played from the boardroom. You don't pick the team for every match. You hire the manager who does, then give them the players, the ground and the money to win.

RUN THE WHOLE CLUB
• Hire and sack managers, each with their own style and formation
• Sign players from the transfer market and sell the ones who don't make it
• Expand the stadium, set the training focus and grow the youth academy
• Negotiate shirt sponsors and keep an eye on the wage bill
• Keep the board and the supporters happy, or be shown the door

PLAYER CARDS
• Every player has a card with six stats, from bronze through silver and gold to purple for the very best
• Spot wonderkids, watch them develop and turn them into legends
• Send scouts to South America, Africa, Europe and Asia for young prospects

MATCHDAY
• Watch every match play out live on a broadcast-style pitch, with goal replays
• Set the formation and mentality, then let the manager do the rest
• Switch to the 3D match view

SEASONS AND CUPS
• League tables, promotion and relegation across seven divisions
• A national cup and a second knockout competition every season
• Season awards, club records and an honours board

COMPETE WITH OTHER CHAIRMEN
• The Weekly Chairman Cup: everyone gets the same club, the same squad and the same luck. One season, and your points go on the leaderboard
• A fresh points race every week, plus all-time boards for trophies, seasons and the richest club
• See the global and friends leaderboards inside the game, and unlock Game Center achievements

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily rewards that grow with your streak
• Exclusive signings offered to your club alone for 24 hours
• Optional reminders at the time you usually play

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your career plays offline and is saved on your iPhone
• Optional in-app purchases for energy refills and transfer funds

All clubs, players and competitions are fictional.

apps.name: Boomer: Airship Cargo Crew
apps.description:
Celebrating the launch of Boomer with a special introductory price!

Welcome aboard, crew member.

Boomer is a fast, focused arcade game set high above the clouds. Slide the cargo net across the deck, catch falling explosives, and react quickly when unusual payloads demand a new strategy.

FREE PLAY
Chase a high score as the pace intensifies. Every missed catch costs a net, so stay sharp and keep the cargo under control.

TIMED SHIFT
Complete a structured airship shift and push through increasingly intense bronze, silver, and gold stages. Earn medals, build your career record, and rise through the crew ranks.

MASTER THE CARGO
Learn how to handle standard, heavy, fuse, split, armored, and phantom bombs. Some need a steady catch. Others call for precise timing, a rail-gun shot, or a second chance on the bounce.

FEATURES
• Two distinct game modes
• Responsive one-touch cargo-net controls
• Special bombs with unique behaviours
• Medal-based career progression and crew ranks
• Game Center friend leaderboards
• Original airship setting, music, and sound
• Adjustable music and sound-effects volume
• No ads and no in-app purchases and there never will be

Report for cargo duty and see how long you can keep the airship flying.

apps.name: BuddyBloom
apps.description:
Build a little world. Find a way home.

Make colorful paths for a friendly sprout Buddy on a floating island. Place cubes, upright or horizontal pillars, ramps, arches and stairs. Rotate, move, paint and try again with undo and redo.

Create freely in Free Build, or explore 15 solo Portal Rescue adventures across Meadow, Forest and Trail, including three optional Meadow practices. Connect climbs, turns and landings, then press Go, Buddy! to try your route.

Need a little help? Ask for a small clue, then choose whether to open an illustrated explanation. There can be more than one way home.

Choose your music volume, glow and scenery motion. Calm and system Reduce Motion offer gentler presentation. Export local backups to keep your saved creations, progress and preferences.

Free Build, solo adventures and music work offline. Update without uninstalling to keep saved play.

apps.name: Buy2Die
apps.description:
Moe is broke. His Platinum Policy pays $1,000,000... if he dies.
There's just one problem: NeverDie Insurance™ will do ANYTHING to keep him alive.

Airbags. Safety nets. Foam-wrapped blades. A sheriff who shoots anything falling on a client.
Every room is a death trap that NeverDie has carefully child-proofed. Your job: find the one way they missed.

• 40 one-screen physics claims: move, jump, shoot, push, pull, and time it perfectly
• One clear rule per room. The challenge is pulling it off.
• Fail and you get CLAIM DENIED (+10 years to your life). Retry instantly.
• Collect every death in the Deathdex: Death by Piano Recital, Death by Seesaw, Death by Diplomacy...
• 29 ridiculous outfits: pirate, viking, astronaut, Count Dracula... Moe still has to wear the helmet.
• Boss claims against Mr. Policy himself.
• One price. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription. Works offline.

Cartoon violence only. Nobody actually gets hurt, except NeverDie's profits.

apps.name: Cardzania
apps.description:
Cardzania brings Benny(more to come soon), the family rummy game, to the table, with no deck to shuffle and no scores to add up.

ONE TABLE, EVERYONE'S PHONE Put the table on an iPad or Apple TV where everyone can see it. Players join from their phones over the home Wi-Fi by scanning the QR code: their hand stays private on their phone, while the table shows the piles, everyone's sets and runs, the scores and what just happened. No accounts, no sign-up, no internet needed. Whatever phone your friends have, they can join: with the Cardzania app, or straight from the phone's web browser.

PLAY AGAINST THE COMPUTER On your own? Play a full game against one to three computer players, on Easy, Normal or Clever. On Apple TV, the whole game plays with the Siri Remote.

HOW BENNY WORKS Thirteen rounds, and the wild card moves on every round: Aces in round one, Twos in round two, all the way up to Kings. Draw a card, lay down sets and runs, add to anyone's sets once you have laid your own, swap the Benny out of a set when you hold the real card, and discard. Place your last card to win the round. Lowest total after the Kings round wins. A full How to Play guide is built in.

YOUR TABLE, YOUR RULES

- Family rules or standard rules, the way your family plays.
- Two to eight players: bigger tables play with six or eight suits.
- Highlight the Bennies, or play like real cards and remember them yourself.
- Name your table, and choose a felt: Classic, Midnight, Ocean, Sunset or Casino.
- Sounds and a quiet music loop, both easy to turn off.
- A dropped phone or a closed app rejoins the table and gets its hand back.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN Cardzania plays over your local network only. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and nothing leaves your home.

apps.name: Clever Leaper
apps.description:
Jump, dodge and do mental math.
Clever Leaper is a one-thumb endless runner where the sharks are the easy part — the math is what scores.
TAP TO JUMP. Dodge the sharks swimming toward you. Land on a shark's back and you bounce off it for points. Hit one with your body and you lose health.

CRACK OPEN A TREASURE CHEST and a math question appears: four answers, fifteen seconds, one tap. Pick the right one and your score is the question's value divided by how long you took — answer fast, score more.

THREE MATH LEVELS
• Normal — two-digit addition and subtraction, two-digit multiplication and division
• Skilled — three-digit addition and subtraction, two-digit by two-digit multiplication
• Master — four-digit addition and subtraction, three-digit by two-digit multiplication, four-digit division

WHAT IT PRACTISES
• Mental arithmetic against the clock
• All four operations, mixed rather than drilled one at a time
• Focus under pressure — stay sharp while dodging
• Instant feedback: your score appears the moment you answer

FOUR OPTIONS, ALWAYS THE SAME SHAPE
Correct and incorrect answers always share the same number of digits, so you cannot guess by length. Two options end in the same digit — you have to actually work it out.

COMPETE ON GAME CENTER
Three separate leaderboards: total score, math score and sharks stomped. Compare with friends and the rest of the world.

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT. NO DATA COLLECTION.
Everything is stored on your device. Nothing is uploaded to us, because there is nowhere for it to go — the app makes no network requests of its own.

Built for one hand, portrait only, and short enough for a queue.

apps.name: CloudBurst: Airship Brawl
apps.description:
Pilot a heavy airship through a sea of clouds, pull alongside your rivals and fire broadsides. Drift out of the storm and you sink.

BROADSIDES IN THE CLOUDS
CloudBurst is a party brawler for up to ten captains. Your airship has real weight: it takes time to get moving, it never brakes, and it drifts long after you let go. Your cannons fire out of both sides and never forward, so every shot means pulling alongside somebody who is trying to do the same to you.

Run out of shells and your guns throw a blast of wind instead: shove a rival into a spire, knock a shell off course, or blow yourself clear of trouble. Fire your harpoon to grab a rival and drag them where you want them, or swing round a rock and sling yourself across the map.

SIX WAYS TO SINK
Every match mixes the modes the host picks, a different one each round.
• Survive: the storm closes in. Be the last ship flying.
• Deathmatch: sixty seconds, unlimited lives, most sinkings wins.
• Sumo: a shrinking ring. Shove everyone else out of it.
• Checkpoints: touch all four checkpoints before anyone else.
• Chase: the safe water follows whoever holds the tag. Be holding it when the clock runs out.
• Race: the course scrolls on without you. Hit the turbo pads, and don't fall behind.

THREE KINDS OF SKY
• Islands: rocky spires that shatter under a single cannonball.
• Minefield: floating mines. Set off a chain and every sinking in it is yours.
• Bumpers: terrain that hits back. Bounce off it, bank shots off it, plan around it.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Up to ten captains online, with players on phones, tablets and computers in the same room.
• Host or join over your local Wi-Fi when your crew is in the same place.
• If the host leaves, the room carries on under a new one.
• Practice on your own against bots, at three difficulty levels.
• An online leaderboard for every mode.
• Paint your own airship and bring it into every game.
• Record your matches and watch them back.
• Touch controls built for two thumbs, or play with a game controller.

apps.name: Cloud Maidens
apps.description:
Cloud Maidens is a cozy puzzle game in the sky. Pick a cloud maiden, and hop from cloud to cloud to get to the other side.

Three cotton-candy clouds float toward you at a time. Only one will hold you. The other two puff apart and you fall. Every level has a secret: the clouds that hold you all belong together. Fruits. Things with a wick. Animals with feathers. Words that sound like a letter. Work out what the right clouds have in common, ten hops in a row, and you made it.

What is inside:

• 165 levels on eleven pages of sky, from fruits and fables to music, maps and words.
• Twelve cloud maidens to play as, each on her own kind of cloud.
• Nineteen real skies: sunrise, northern lights, the Milky Way, a solar eclipse, a double rainbow and more, each with its own things floating by.
• Mystery clouds between hops. Open one and it could be a powerup, a trick or a growing plant. You won't know until you touch it.
• Hearts, shields, slow motion and more to save for when you need them.
• Two baddies to watch for: Rotten Candy, who drifts across the sky, and Thunder Idol Lei Gong, who makes you hop your way back.
• A hint button when you want the level's topic, and automatic play when you just want to keep going.
• Fastest times, levels finished and fewest falls, kept on your phone.

There are no lives to run out of. A fall starts the level again, and you can try as often as you like.

Buy it once and it is all yours. No ads, no sign-in and nothing more to buy. Cloud Maidens works without the internet and does not collect anything about you; your progress and times stay on your phone.

apps.name: Cult Girls
apps.description:
Talia is thirty, newly single, and done asking permission. Run with her through eight levels, from a girls’ night downtown to the cliffs of Santorini, and make the choices that decide how her story ends.

Tap to jump. Grab candles, books, hearts and roses. Dodge gossip, ringing phones and a storm of certified letters. Between runs, Talia chooses how to answer her family, her friends and the group she grew up in.

• Eight levels, each with its own setting and hazards
• A branching story with four endings
• Cover and character art from the graphic novel Cult Girls by Natalie Grand, illustrated by Cassandre Bolan
• No ads, no purchases, no accounts, and it plays offline

Cult Girls: The Game is a work of fiction. The Lantern Assembly and its members are invented.

apps.name: Dice Vice
apps.description:
Dice Vice is two things in one: a beautiful dice roller you'll actually want to use, and a fast, ruthless bluffing game to play with friends.

ROLL
Open it and roll. Tap or shake to throw up to ten dice — classic or full 3D with real tumbling animation. Pick your roll mode: throw them all, LOCK the keepers and reroll the rest (hello, Yahtzee night), or roll one die at a time. Settle a bet, run your board game, pick who's buying the next round.

BLUFF
When you've got friends and a few minutes — the bar, the line, the back of an Uber — start a round. Everyone shakes their own cup and hides their dice, then you bid on how many of a face are across the whole table. Think the last bid is a lie? Call it. Here's the twist: you're not grinding down to a lone survivor — you're racing to get RID of your dice. Win your calls, ditch your dice, and whoever's still holding when it's over buys the round.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• LOSER BUYS — the main event. Race to shed every die. Last one still holding buys the round.
• SPRINT — fastest game in the house. First player to zero dice wins.
• CLASSIC — pure Liar's Dice. Get caught lying and lose a die; last one standing wins.

BUILT FOR THE TABLE
• INSTANT INVITES — Friends scan your QR code and play from their phone browser. No install, no account — they're in the game in seconds. Or share the 4-letter room code.
• PRIVATE ROOMS — Lock your table with a PIN.
• BOTS & TIMERS — Add a bot to fill a seat; set a turn timer to keep the game moving.
• TABLE TALK — Fire off reactions to celebrate a great call or needle a bad one. Build your own 8-emoji tray.
• KEEP SCORE — Win/loss ledgers for every mode and 9 ranked achievements, from First Blood to Trash Talker.
• MAKE IT YOURS — Dice colors, looks & animated dice (Hellfire, Black Ice, Tesla, Neon Sign), shake-to-roll, haptics, high-contrast dice.
• NO JUNK — No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Just the game.

Beautifully made, with a leather-and-brass table that feels like your favorite dive.

Dice Vice Premium (optional, one-time): unlock full 3D dice and finishes, table skins, an exclusive reaction pack, and a supporter badge. Dice color packs are also available individually. Cosmetics only — purchases never affect the game. Everyone plays on an even table.

Roll the dice. Call the bluff.

apps.name: Dunewarden
apps.description:
A castle is only as strong as the kingdom behind it.

Dunewarden is an offline 3D castle-building and siege strategy game. Grow a settlement, protect its supply lines and command an army against rival castles. Rotate, pan and zoom to see your frontier from every angle.

BUILD A WORKING KINGDOM
Watch woodcutters travel to trees, quarry workers gather stone and carriers deliver supplies to storage. Balance food, housing, taxes and production. Build farms, mills, bakeries, workshops, markets and fortifications. Tap workers to inspect their jobs, destinations and cargo.

COMMAND THE WALLS
Connect stairs, towers and battlements. Move infantry onto your defenses, station archers and control your gates. Recruit spearmen, swordsmen, cavalry and siege engines. Use troop groups, rectangle selection, rally points and retreat commands to direct the battle.

CHOOSE YOUR FRONTIER
Play five authored Frontier Chronicles: defend an oasis, hold a mountain pass, restore a damaged fortress, manage scarce timber or conquer across a river. Or create a skirmish across oasis, canyon, coast, river and highland landscapes, with three map sizes and up to three offline rivals. Peaceful mode lets you build without enemy attacks.

RIVALS THAT RESPOND
Opposing rulers scout, expand their economies, recruit armies, raid supplies and defend their keeps. Choose your difficulty and win by defeating rival keeps.

A KINGDOM IN MOTION
Animated workers, soldiers, wildlife and hauling carts bring the map to life. Resource piles reflect your stores; siege impacts, damaged structures, positional work sounds and an adaptive instrumental score follow the action.

ONE PURCHASE. YOUR WHOLE KINGDOM.
All scenarios and skirmish options are included. No ads, in-app purchases, subscription or account. Single-player gameplay runs offline. Saves stay on your device; there is no cross-device cloud sync. Includes pause, speed controls, camera buttons and separate sound options.

Requires iOS 17 or later. By CST3 Media, LLC.

apps.name: DuoDeka
apps.description:
TWO PLAYERS. TWELVE SPACES. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES.

DuoDeka is a 2-player strategy game where every move can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Take turns making your moves and try to be the first to complete one of six winning patterns. Sounds simple? Think again!

The unique game mechanics, featuring orange and red blocked spaces, create surprising twists and new tactical challenges. No two games are ever the same. Plan ahead, disrupt your opponent’s strategy, and find the decisive move. Whether you’re looking for a quick rematch or an intense duel with friends, DuoDeka combines easy-to-learn rules with surprisingly deep strategic gameplay.

Are you ready to put your skills to the test? Download DuoDeka now and be among the first to discover the new strategy game!

apps.name: Fakin It XL
apps.description:
Fakin’ It XL is bringing good, (mostly) clean, lying fun to your next game night! 

One of the most beloved Jackbox party games is getting a fresh coat of paint. In Fakin’ It XL, players receive a simple instruction on their phone or device. Something like, “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Easy enough, right? Except one player, the Faker, never got the prompt and has to blend in like they know exactly what’s going on. Make a split decision to try to convince everyone you’re in the loop. Once the real prompt is revealed, the Faker must have a good lie queued up to explain themself! 

It’s up to the group to sniff out the Faker by grilling each other about their answers, and it’s the Faker’s job to lie through their teeth and shift the blame onto someone else. Survive three rounds of interrogation without getting caught and you’ll walk away with a mountain of points. 

What’s New? 

We’ve taken the bones of the Fakin’ It you know and love with round types and content, borrowed from the updated structure of Fakin’ It All Night Long, and added brand-new content and questions types. 

And, you no longer need to save this one solely for in-person gatherings. We’ve added a new mode to make it easier and more fun to play with your friends online. At the start of the game, you’ll be able to select whether you’re playing with folks in the room or remotely via a stream or video call. Then, you’ll receive round types customized to that experience so it’s easy to play together or from afar. 

Only one person needs to own the game for everyone to play. Use your phone, tablet, or any web-enabled device as your controller to jump right in.

apps.name: Fold Supply Arcade
apps.description:
Fold Arcade brings the alley roller back, and puts it on a phone that folds.

Open your iPhone Duo like a laptop and the game becomes a machine: the lane lies flat on the table and the board stands up in front of you. Tilt the screen back and the board leans with it. Put a finger on the ball, flick it up the lane, and watch it climb the ramp and drop into a pocket.

HOT ROLL
• Nine balls a game. Pockets score from 10 to 100.
• Land two balls in a row in 20 or better and the next one pays double. Keep the streak going and it pays triple.
• Real arcade sounds: the roll, the thump, the jingle for a good shot.
• Enter your initials on a pixel high-score board.

TICKETS AND PRIZES
• Every 10 points is a ticket, and the machine feeds them out as you play.
• Take them to the prize counter, under the neon sign.
• Twenty prizes to collect, from spider rings and sticky hands to a boombox and a lava lamp.
• Fill your collection and the counter throws you a party.

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO, PLAYS ON ANY iPHONE
• On iPhone Duo the fold is part of the game: board on the upright half, lane on the flat half.
• On any other iPhone, lay it flat and play the same machine on one screen.

NO STRINGS
• No ads.
• No in-app purchases. Tickets are won, never bought.
• No account and no internet connection needed.
• Nothing about you leaves your phone.

Fold Arcade is made by Fold Supply, makers of wallpapers for iPhone Duo.

apps.name: FuzzyRoller
apps.description: Roll, hop, and outsmart the cats! Guide Pepper and friends through 21 escapes across seven worlds. Dodge moving obstacles, collect seeds and stars, master cat-chase finales, and replay levels to improve your best run. Pick a hamster and find your way to freedom. Designed for offline solo play. Progress and sound settings are stored on your device. No account is required.

apps.name: Glockental
apps.description:
Glockental is a match-3 game that sends you on a real break now and then.

THE CUCKOO BREAK
After a while the cuckoo clock strikes. Kuno the cuckoo pops out and lays three cards in front of you: move a little, look out of the window, have a drink, take a breath, tidy up a bit, message someone, or something from your own list. Pick one, put the phone down, and tap “Done!” afterwards. What you did goes into your break log.
• You decide: off, gentle, normal or strict, and how often the cuckoo calls.
• Calling it a day is always one tap away.
• No streaks, no guilt, nothing to lose.
• Never in the middle of a level.

THE GAME
• 30 levels on the clock tower square, with gearboxes, cuckoo clocks, figurines, crates, cloth and padlocks.
• Special pieces and combos, and a victory lap after every short stretch.
• The toolbelt fills up as you play and hands you boosters.
• Day, evening and night on the square follow your own clock.

FAIR
• Pay once, that’s it: no ads, no lives, no waiting, no in-app purchases.
• Plays offline.
• Your data stays on your iPhone: Glockental collects nothing.

More districts are planned.

apps.name: 6-7 GO!
apps.description:
6-7 GO! — THREE GAMES. ONE CHALLENGE!

Think you have perfect timing? Quick reflexes? Great concentration? Can you challenge a friend and keep your balance?

Welcome to 6-7 GO! — a colorful collection of three exciting mini-games that challenge your sense of time, attention, reaction speed, and coordination.

Whether you're playing solo or with friends, every second counts!

MORE THAN JUST FUN!

6-7 GO! combines entertainment with playful challenges involving focus, timing accuracy, quick decisions, movement control, and hand-eye coordination.

Each mini-game offers a different way to test your skills, challenge yourself, and discover your personal best.

FEEL 6-7 — MASTER YOUR TIMING

Can you stop a hidden timer at exactly 6.70 seconds?

• Choose between Tap and Hold.
• Trust your instincts — no visible countdown!
• Discover how accurately you can sense time.
• Play solo or enjoy Pass & Play with friends.
• Compare your results across multiple rounds.

Every fraction of a second matters!

6-7 DUEL — CHALLENGE A FRIEND

Two players. One device. One exciting challenge!

• React quickly to the numbers 6 and 7.
• Master Tap and Hold actions.
• Explore Classic, Switch, and Training modes.
• Test your attention and reaction speed.
• Discover the winner of each round.
• Enjoy playful animations and victory celebrations.

Stay focused — the next move could decide the round!

6-7 BALANCE — FIND YOUR BALANCE

Turn your device into an interactive motion challenge!

• Use gentle movements to keep 6 and 7 balanced.
• Maintain your balance for 6.70 seconds.
• Explore different movement challenges.
• Choose your preferred difficulty.
• Adjust motion sensitivity to match your play style.
• Test your coordination, concentration, and movement control.

Keep steady, stay focused, and celebrate your success!

WHY PLAY 6-7 GO?

• Three unique mini-games in one app.
• Fun challenges involving attention and concentration.
• Quick sessions that are easy to start.
• Solo and multiplayer gameplay on one device.
• Colorful graphics and playful animations.
• Music, sound effects, and voice feedback.
• Adjustable audio and appearance settings.
• Support for multiple languages.
• Designed for supported iPhone and iPad devices.
• No account required to play.

JUST ONE MORE TRY!

Can you get closer to 6.70 seconds?

Can you react faster than your friend?

Can you master the perfect balance?

Whether you love casual games, reaction challenges, or playful tests of concentration, 6-7 GO! brings three entertaining experiences together.

READY? GO!

Download 6-7 GO! and make every second count!

apps.name: Hatter: Hat, Alias & Charades
apps.description:
Hatter brings The Hat, Alias and Charades to one phone. Explain words, guess clues and act things out with friends. Split into teams or take turns around the circle. Built-in word decks work offline, with no account required.

THE HAT: ONE DECK, THREE ROUNDS
The same cards return for three different challenges:
• describe the word using other words;
• act it out with gestures, as in Charades;
• give a single-word clue in the final round.
Remember answers from earlier rounds and help your team score. Finish the deck before the timer ends and your remaining time carries into the next round with the same explainer and guessers.

ALIAS: EXPLAIN AND GUESS WORDS
Describe the card without saying the answer or words with the same root. Guess as many cards as you can before your turn ends. Adjust the turn timer, deck size and skip penalty to suit your group.

CHARADES: LET YOUR GESTURES DO THE TALKING
Use gestures and facial expressions instead of words. Play at a party, during a game night or on a trip with friends.

PLAY IN TEAMS OR AROUND THE CIRCLE
Create teams with playful names and emblems, and edit player names. In individual play, only the next player in the circle guesses. Both the explainer and the guesser earn a point for a correct answer. Pass one phone from player to player.

CHOOSE YOUR TOPICS AND DIFFICULTY
Explore general words, anime, cinema, sports, games, food, nature and brands. Decks include single words and phrases. Choose easy, medium, hard or a mix of levels. Add character and famous-person cards separately, with a “Who is this?” hint when you need one.

YOUR WORDS AND COMMUNITY PACKS
In The Hat, each player can secretly add cards to a shared deck. Find community packs by title, topic, author or words, and sort by newest or most liked. Publish your own Russian or English collections. Every pack works with all three game modes.

KEEP YOUR GAME MOVING
A 3, 2, 1 countdown gives the explainer time to get ready. Large cards, a timer and clear Correct and Skip buttons keep turns simple. See final scores and the players who explained the most words. Switch between English and Russian, light and dark themes, and turn sounds on or off. Your game is saved automatically.

OFFLINE PLAY, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Play with built-in decks without an internet connection. A selected community pack is saved with your game. Internet access is needed for the catalog, likes, sign-in and publishing. An account is only required to publish packs: playing and liking packs do not require registration.

No ads.
Developed by Ardcode
Support: codeard@gmail.com

apps.name: Hexabeat Game
apps.description:
Hexabeat is a minimalist survival game with geometric shapes.

You control a hexagon with a single thumb. Your weapons fire on their own, on the beat. Enemies keep coming, and the goal is to last as long as you can.

• On level up, pick 1 of 3 upgrades: bolt, crystals orbiting around you, shockwaves, spikes and more (13 in total).
• 7 enemy types that appear over time, plus a Colossus every minute.
• You have 5 hearts; some upgrades give more.
• Colors, rhythm and upgrades change every day.
• Local records: your 10 best runs and your best time of the day.
• Settings for volume, vibration, audio latency and language (Spanish and English).
• Works offline. No ads and no in-app purchases.

apps.name: IQ-Gym
apps.description:
IQ-Gym is a calm brain gym for your reasoning. Work through short sessions of puzzles and tests in the style of classic IQ assessments, learn the thinking behind each type, and watch your accuracy grow. No ads, no account, no internet needed.

SIX AREAS TO TRAIN
• Number Series: find the rule behind a run of numbers.
• Verbal Reasoning: analogies, odd one out and logic statements.
• Matrix Reasoning: complete a grid of figures by finding its rules.
• Spatial Reasoning: turn, flip, count and fold shapes in your head.
• Memory & Attention: sequence recall, Schulte table, Stroop and reverse recall.
• Processing Speed: size and code comparison, running arithmetic and dual n-back.
Every area has four levels, from easy warm-ups to expert puzzles with layered rules.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• Levels: scored, timed sessions. Pick an area and a difficulty.
• Practice: the same puzzles without the clock. Each one starts with questions that show you how to think about it, and up to three hints, from gentle to specific.
• Targeted: five puzzles from the patterns you get wrong most, chosen from your own answers.
• Learn: 50 short lessons: the idea, a worked example and where it shows up in real life.
• Progress: your accuracy by area and level, and the patterns that need work.

A COACH THAT EXPLAINS, NOT JUST SCORES
Every answer comes with an explanation of the rule, and a wrong answer adds a tip for that kind of puzzle. Answers given with hints are kept out of your accuracy, so your progress stays honest.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Endless generated number series, matrices and spatial puzzles, plus a hand-written verbal set.
• Dark and light themes, optional sound effects.
• Relaxed or untimed levels if you would rather think than race.
• Plays upright or sideways, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
• In English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Armenian, Japanese and Korean.
• Your progress stays on your device. Export it or reset it at any time.

GOOD TO KNOW
IQ-Gym is for fun and self-training. It is not a clinical or medical tool, it is not an IQ test, and its scores are not an IQ measurement.

apps.name: Junkyard Jolt
apps.description:
Born in the scrap. Built to rise.

Bolt has one big eye, a bigger heart, and a sweetheart orbiting a little too far from home. Bounce from a rusty junkyard toward the stars to reach S.A.L., a satellite with a sharp wit and a few spare parts of her own.

Junkyard Jolt is a portrait arcade climber with automatic bouncing, touch steering, richly rendered robot artwork, and an adventurous original soundtrack.

SCRAP BECOMES SUPERPOWERS
Collect two wings to fly, fire a short rocket burst, bounce higher on mattress springs, attract bolts with a magnet, and carry a one-hit shield. Discover Electro-Pogo and Iron Glider combinations. Assemble a Vacuum Bot from a magnet and radiator fan, or a Scrap Surfer from wheels and sheet metal. Powers are temporary; your discoveries stay in the notebook.

TAKE THE SECRET ROUTE
Choose a purple portal or keep climbing. Your phone stays upright while Bolt flies right with foot boosters. Steer up and down through flying scrap, lasers, spinning blades, and orbital traffic. A collision ejects you back into the climb: collected bolts stay, but the exit reward is lost. Reach the exit for an earnable workshop part.

MAKE BOLT YOUR OWN
Find 20 earnable cosmetic parts across five slots: headgear, body panels, arms, boots, and finishes. Mix your finds into three named, saved designs. Show off your creation under garage spotlights and share a portrait character card. Every build follows the same jumping and scoring rules.

MORE REASONS TO COME BACK
Play three fixed, replayable Scrap Challenges with their own records and one-time first-clear scrap bonuses. Record your best Endless climb and race its non-contact ghost along the seeded starting course. No online leaderboard or daily streak requirement.

BUILD A LITTLE HOME
Choose an active contract from a board of nine jobs. Complete them to earn six garage repairs and uncover postcards from the scrapyard. No repair timers.

RESCUE. RACE. REPEAT.
Climb through five atmospheric zones in Story, with captioned opening and ending cinematics. Escape a collapsing crane, runaway scrap train, and satellite breakup. Rescue S.A.L. to unlock her as a playable character; earn five rivalry medals to unlock Rivet. Optional Bolt and S.A.L. radio captions add a little heart to the climb.

OPTIONAL JUNKYARD COLLECTIONS
Space Scrappers and Foundry Forged each add five cosmetic pieces for Bolt. Clank and Ember are optional playable characters with their own signature looks. Each is a separate one-time purchase; none changes jumping physics, hitboxes, or scoring. The 20 earnable parts, S.A.L., and Rivet remain included unlocks.

PLAY YOUR WAY
* Portrait touch controls with automatic bouncing
* Story, Endless, Scrap Challenges, workshop, and garage
* Optional offline rival races and best-run ghost
* Mute and reduced-motion settings
* Captioned story cinematics
* Offline core gameplay and local progress

No account is needed for the included game. Progress, records, and designs are saved on your device; cloud saves and cross-device transfer are not included. Sharing is optional and uses your device's sharing tools.

One more bounce. One step closer to S.A.L.

apps.name: Laf - Okey with Words
apps.description:
Draw. Rack. Drop.

Build sets across languages in an Okey-inspired game using Laf tiles.

SOLO GAME
Unlimited play at no extra cost. Play against bots at your own pace, save your game and pick up where you left off. No credits needed.

LIVE GAME
Join friends at the table or enter tournaments. Match by playing language and level. Claim 24 daily credits, or buy more when you want. Multiplayer entry costs 12 credits. Purchased credits belong to your selected playing language and level.

Play in English, Turkish, or Spanish. Menus and translations are also available in Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese, German, French, Hindi, and Simplified Chinese.

No ads. Sign in with Apple or Google.

apps.name: Midnight Theatre
apps.description:
Plan a card performance with two assistants in Midnight Theatre.

FAYE holds one exposed top card in each of two independent storage slots, opening space for later moves. NOA lets you choose one card from the next three in the stock.

The emergency trick brings out a hidden candidate card using an assistant as a pledge. Collect that assistant within the action limit or lose the ability. Undo restores the cards, assistant state and remaining actions.

Confirm clears to advance through four campaign acts. Choose curtains, props, lighting and a program of tricks; their combinations affect the theatre evaluation. Stage performances unlock after four campaign acts.

Try Menu → Rehearsal to use all three card abilities from the start. Chain offers separate rank-connection puzzles and stage mechanics. Hints, undo and local saves support continued play.

apps.name: Music Pairs: Find the Song
apps.description:
Every card hides a song – and each song is there exactly twice. Take turns flipping cards, listen closely and find the pairs. Music Pairs is a concentration game for 2 to 8 players on one device.

• Play with your own music on your device or in Apple Music (recommended) or with Audius – other streaming services are not supported
• Time bonus and combo points for streaks of matches
• Game history and player photos
• 2 to 32 pairs per game
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Apple Music: songs that are only in the cloud need a subscription. Audius needs an internet connection; its songs come from independent artists, are not reviewed and may contain explicit lyrics.

Player photos and game history stay on your device.

apps.name: Ocean Story - Spice War
apps.description:
DESCRIPTION (4,000-character limit)
Read the prices. Pick the port. Beat the monsoon.

Ocean Story - Spice War is a sailing roguelike set in the 17th-century Spice Islands, where nutmeg and clove are worth more than gold. A season is one long voyage: a chain of contracts that arrives as a route rather than a list, so every port offers two or three ways on, each with its own days at sea, its own pay and its own rumours. The monsoon window is thirty, sixty or ninety days — and when it closes, the season ends with whatever you are holding.

FIVE CHECKLISTS, ONE WIN
Five ways to finish a season, all of them listed on the tactical map:
• Lord — sink the season's pirate king, take his treasure, deliver it.
• Trade — grow a fortune, hold a quarter of two merchant houses, profit at sea.
• Diplomacy — two powers allied, a relic given, a noble escorted home.
• Legend — most of the islands visited, the old places' secrets, the relics.
• Spice — three plantations owned, harvested and supplied to the ports.

A WORLD THAT MOVES WHILE YOU SAIL
Prices are not a table. People eat, leave and arrive; a town that cannot feed its people empties out and takes its prices with it; powers go to war over a harbour and put a blockade on the road you were planning to use. Merchant hulls read the same prices you do and arbitrage the difference between two islands. Rumours are old news: a price from ten days ago is a question mark, one from yesterday is solid.

SIX HULLS
The caravel and the longship are free; the merchantman, warship, treasure ship and ship of the line are bought at the yard. Every hull eats water and food, every day, at sea — fresh water is heavier than gold, so a hold full of water is a slow ship, and both of them are thirsty.

THE BROADSIDE
Left and right sides load separately. A gun takes four seconds and gunners, and a hull with more guns needs more of them. Three kinds of shot: round shot breaks hulls, grape shreds sails and kills crew, explosive wrecks the rudder. Damage stays until a yard repairs it. Five days of nothing but meat and the crew starts to fail — eat grain, or sail into a port.

TEN SAVE SLOTS, A HUNDRED-PAGE CODEX
Ten save slots, each on its own map. A codex of thirteen categories and about a hundred entries — goods, hulls, relics, powers, merchant houses, the islands — written from the world's own data.

TOUCH, KEYBOARD AND GAMEPAD, ENGLISH AND CHINESE
The iPhone layout puts the helm, sails, guns and charts at your fingertips. Bluetooth game controllers and keyboards are also supported. The interface switches between English and Chinese from the main menu.

PRIVACY
The complete single-player game works offline with no account. Optional Game Center achievements use Apple's service only when the player opens achievements or reports progress. No tracking, advertising, in-app purchases, analytics, or crash reporting. Saves stay in the app's own container.

Requires iOS 17 or later.

apps.name: Oil Game Story
apps.description:
It is 1900. You have twenty-five thousand dollars, a hunch and a hat.

Every sensible man in town says there is nothing under that hill. Lease it anyway. Sink the hole. And when she comes in, do it again, for a hundred and thirty years.

OIL GAME STORY is a calm, deep game about getting rich in the oil business: the land, the wells, the cheques, and the long patience in between.

THE DECISIONS ARE YOURS
• Read the map and take the lease before the big companies do.
• Sign the paperwork for every well. Keep it all, or lay the risk off on partners.
• At casing point the rig wires you what the hole shows: run pipe, or plug her and keep the money.
• Drill it up, flood it, sell it, or sit on it and wait for the price.

THEN THE MONEY COMES IN
• A cheque on the first of every month, and a counter at the top that never stops turning.
• A file for every well: what it cost, what it made, whether it ever paid out.
• Barn burners, dusters and dogs. You will have all three.

A CENTURY OF BOOMS AND BUSTS
• Real prices, real history: the gusher age, the boomtowns, a dime a barrel in the Depression, the embargo, the long bust, the shale revolution.
• Thirteen eras, from cable-tool rigs to three-mile laterals.
• Leases on the Arctic coast that nobody wants, and no pipeline for nine years. Seventy-million-dollar wildcats in the deep water of the Gulf. Countries abroad that keep their share and sometimes change their minds.
• And after 2030 the game does not stop. There is always another frontier, and the next one is further out than you think.

A COMPANY WITH A PAYROLL
• Landmen, geologists, tool pushers, bookkeepers: each with a face, a knack and an opinion, and now and then the nerve to voice it.
• Two dozen rival companies with silly names, every one of them after your acreage.
• Thirty-two painted newsreels for the big moments. None is ever forced on you.

A GAME TO LEAVE RUNNING
• Made to sit beside your work: the wells pump, the rig turns, and you look up when one comes in.
• Stops the clock for the big news, or never, as you like.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, either way up.

ONE PRICE. THAT IS ALL.
No ads. No timers. No gems. No account. No internet needed, and nothing collected: the game makes no network calls at all. The only thing it wants you to buy is more acreage.

The companies in the game are inventions, and any likeness to a real one is parody. The voices are AI-generated.

apps.name: Orbit Duel - DareDoesGames
apps.description:
AIM AROUND THE PLANETS.
No ads. No energy meter. No account. No analytics. No internet. Just gravity.

FEATURES
