- Every planet pulls your shot. Curve it, slingshot it, sometimes it comes back.
- Two to eight players: pass one phone, add computer players on Easy, Medium or Hard, or play one phone each nearby with no internet.
- One to five lives each. Each hit costs a life; the last ship flying wins.
- Play 1, 3, 5 or 10 rounds, or keep going.
- Watch shots at 1x, 3x or 5x, or hold the screen to fast forward. Every collision slows down and zooms in.
- Pause any time, on any phone.
- Build your own ship: eight hulls, sixteen paints, four shots and six trails.
- Aim with a joystick wherever your finger lands, then fine-tune.
- Your last shot stays on the field, faint, so you can adjust.

apps.name: Pigeon’s Mission
apps.description:
SAVE MOM & DAD!

One night, a little pigeon named Archie fell asleep. When he woke up, his whole family was gone, snatched by Crazy Guy, a goo-mutated villain with very big plans. Archie can't fly, but he's going anyway.

Pigeon's Mission is a pixel-packed platformer bursting with heart, humor and a whole lot of jumping. Wall-jump, dash and battle your way across seven dreamy worlds, outsmart bosses with backstories, and bring Archie's family home.


IT STARTED WITH A SKETCHBOOK
Logan was six when he walked up to his dad with an idea: he wanted to make his own video game. His dad JUMPED at it. Logan ran to his sketchbook and drew everything: the hero, the enemies, the worlds and the final villain. A small team signed on, and those pencil drawings became the game you're holding. Every character you'll meet started on one of Logan's pages.


TIGHT, SNAPPY, MADE FOR YOUR THUMBS
Wall-slides, midair dashes and combo attacks, with on-screen controls tuned so Archie moves the instant you do. Easy to pick up. Hard to put down.

EVERY SEED IS A CHOICE
Meet the Harvest Pulse System. Golden Seeds power every gadget you carry. Collect them from enemies and hidden corners, then decide: glide over the gap, blast the snail, or save up for something bigger?

SEVEN WHIMSICAL WORLDS
• Hill Hopping: your cozy intro to the adventure
• Dusty Dunes: enemy waves and desert wind puzzles
• Rocky Road: heavy combat and hidden smash paths
• Splashy Streams: underwater puzzles and glowing ruins
• Whacky Woods: carnival chaos meets high-speed coasters
• Heavenly Hike: skyborn combat and floating islands
• Cosmic Craft: the final showdown in a high-tech alien lair

SEVEN QUIRKY GADGETS
Glide with the Winged Wonder. Blast with the Pinecone Launcher. Suck up trouble with the DustBuster. Smash with the Rocky Hammer. Dive with the Hydro Helm. Rise with the Phoenix Feather. Then climb into the Tech Mech power suit for the grand finale.

MEET THE CREW
Archie Airborne: the hero. Can't fly.
Big Bob: the muscle. Also the snacks.
Meg: the heart. And the brains.

BOSSES WITH BIG PERSONALITIES
Big Bug digs, rolls and drops from above. Rocky Ronster throws fire punches over rising lava. The Magnificent Marvo, a magic squirrel, fights with illusions. Then come Ray the Rat, Whirlpool Wave, Flam, Crazy Guy himself, and one more we're keeping secret.


WHY FAMILIES LOVE IT
• Fun for kids, rewarding for seasoned platformer fans
• 4 to 6 hours of story
• No ads. No accounts. No in-app purchases. Ever.
• Plays offline, perfect for road trips and flights
• A real story about a real kid who dreamed big

BACKED AND FEATURED
• Kickstarter Project We Love, funded by 258 backers
• Featured by GameMaker
• Game Devs of Color Expo selection
• OTK Games Expo 2025 Chat Choice Award

Ready? Archie's family is waiting. Let's go!

PigeonsMission.com
A Glowing Cheetah Studios game, Miami, FL.

apps.name: Pudding Racers
apps.description:
Welcome to a kart world made of sugar! In Pudding Racers you zoom through Pudding Park, Lollipop Lagoon, Cotton Candy Fair, Gingerbread Town and the Ice Cream Alps – with drifts, speed and plenty of sugar. And everyone races together: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV in the same race.

EVERYONE RACES TOGETHER
• Crossplay: iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV share the same race
• Up to 8 players on the same Wi-Fi network or via Personal Hotspot – no internet needed, just a short room code
• Online races against other players over the internet – with friends, you race together on Wi-Fi with a room code
• Bots fill the grid up to 12 racers, and there’s a Tournament mode too
• Emotes that everyone in the race can see

DRIVE WITH FEEL
• Drift for a Sugar Boost: hold your drift through Pinch and Spoon all the way to Bag, then let go and zoom!
• Bubblegum Start: hit the gas to the beat on 3, 2 and 1 and launch with a Sugar Boost.
• Cotton Candy Draft: stay close behind another kart and get pulled along.
• Stunts: spin in mid-air and land clean for an extra boost.

THE SUGAR JAR
No random item boxes here: your Sugar Jar fills up when you drive well – with Sugar Pearls, drifts, stunts and overtakes. Before the race you pick one of five recipes, from Soda Fountain to Pop Bonbon, and fire it at just the right moment. Everyone fills their jar at the same speed, no matter their position.

SINGLE PLAYER
• Race up to 11 bots across six difficulty levels, from Cozy to Extra Sour
• Treat Tour: several races in a row, with a Cake Podium and a Prize Lollipop
• Time Chase: race your own Glass Ghost and beat the Royal Baker’s time – with a Game Center world leaderboard for the fastest lap on each track
• Three Daily Tasks that change every day, three cherries on every track and 12 badges – which you also collect as Game Center achievements

GARAGE AND RACER
• Build your kart from body, tires, spoiler and engine – the parts change how it handles
• Paint jobs, stickers, antennas, turbo flames and horns for your style
• Five racers, including a gummy bear, a marshmallow bunny and an ice cream penguin – plus hats, glasses, scarves, colors and emotes
• Earn Bonbon Bucks in every race. Racers and accessories are purely cosmetic – on the track, only skill counts.
• Bucks packs are also available as optional In-App Purchases.

ONE PURCHASE FOR ALL YOUR DEVICES
Buy once, race everywhere: Pudding Racers runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. iCloud brings your progress to every device signed in with the same Apple Account – Bucks, unlocked items, records and badges included. You can turn this off in OPTIONS.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Customizable touch controls and game controllers, plus keyboard on iPad
• On Apple TV you need a game controller (tvOS 27 or later)
• Playable offline: single player and Wi-Fi races need no internet
• No ads, no tracking

apps.name: Puffy Garage Spatial
apps.description:
Open the night garage on Apple Vision Pro!

A glowing toy garage appears on your table. Ten cute cars wait in their own bays: Police Car, Fire Truck, Digger, Monster Truck, Race Car, City Car, Off-Roader, Buggy, Ice Cream Van and Camper. Tap a car and it jumps onto the turntable in front of you.

TAP TO PAINT
• Tap any part of your car and paint it: the body, the stripes, the wheels or a part you added
• Spin the car around with your fingers to see every side

40 COOL PARTS
• Sirens, rockets, shark fins, dragon heads, bubble makers, magnets, disco balls, fireworks, rainbow exhaust and more
• Toy, sport and giant monster wheels
• All parts are ready to use, no stars or unlocking needed

PICK A DRIVER
• Ten plush puffs can drive: Teddy, Bunbun, Mochi, Pandy, Ribbit, Puffy, Rexy, Coco, Hamham and Fifi
• Dress them up with racing helmets, police caps, fire helmets, crowns, cowboy hats, shades and goggles

DRIVE!
Your car jumps onto the little road, races two laps around the garage and comes back. Sirens flash, rockets roar and fireworks pop.

BIG CAR!
Tap Big car! and your car appears life-sized on your floor. Walk around it, look inside and keep painting.

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• Just look and tap your fingers
• Big picture buttons, no reading needed
• Cheerful garage music and fun sounds

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No accounts and no internet needed
• Nothing leaves the device

apps.name: Puzzled Puzzler
apps.description:
A frame drops. It lands, and smoke rolls around the whole frame. For ten seconds the whole picture is yours to remember. Then it comes apart.

Pieces fall at a steady pace. Slide a piece sideways, turn it, or flip it, and it keeps coming down. You cannot park it in the air. When it reaches the floor, the next piece waits five seconds, then falls. Next shows that piece and counts the wait. A faint ghost marks the landing. A light tune plays until you turn it off in Settings. Sound effects are separate.

Rotate it a quarter turn. Flip it across, or flip it down. The picture is not the same in a mirror, so the facing has to agree, not only the outline. Drop it on the matching part of the picture, or nudge a landed piece and tap Place. The right square and the right facing lock with a click. A wrong one stays in your hands.

A piece that has landed stays where you leave it. Move them apart. If four unplaced pieces overlap in one pile, that picture is lost. The piece still falling does not count, and neither does a piece you have already locked. When the last piece has fallen, a 60-second finish clock starts. When it runs out, you win the picture if two or fewer pieces are still out of place or loose; otherwise Start Level Over tries it again.

Twenty levels, each with more pieces than the one before.

Twenty pictures. The first ten are a meadow, a harbor, an orchard, a canyon, a night market, a glacier, an observatory, a reef, a train, and a rose window. The next ten are a kite hill, a bakery, a pond, a clock tower, a fair, a snow village, a library, a pumpkin patch, a ferry, and a firework garden. Each frame asks for more than the one before it. The last three keep 52 pieces and grow the board. Early frames trace the sockets. Later ones leave you with the memory of the ten seconds.

A bedroom floor full of stray things. A kitchen counter lost under mugs. A study where nothing made it back to the shelf. Tidy Room! hands you the mess and a few baskets, and asks you to put it right.

Each basket names what it wants. Hunt through the room, tap the right things, and watch the clutter disappear. Objects hide under other objects, so the fun is in the order: what do you pick up first?

Play at your own pace. There is no countdown, just a room that looks better every time you find the thing a basket asked for.

What you will do
• Explore illustrated rooms, from quiet studies to busy kitchens
• Fill baskets by finding the items they ask for
• Dig through piles to reach what is hidden underneath
• Plan your taps so the tray does not overflow
• Clear one level and start the next

One room at a time, until the house feels like home again.

apps.name: Arrow Story: Home Design
apps.description:
Welcome to Arrow Story: Home Design! A relaxing arrow puzzle game that trains your brain.
SOS! A woman and her dog lost their home to a fire. A family is caught in a blizzard. They need your help.
Come to Arrow Story: Home Design. Solve arrow puzzles, collect stars, and help people in need rebuild their homes and get back to happy lives.
It's a heartfelt arrow puzzle game where every level brings a change you can see. Spend the stars you earn to repair their broken homes until the place looks new again. One repair at a time, you put their lives back together.
➡️ Arrow Puzzle Gameplay
Arrows cover every grid, and each one can only travel the way it points. That means one arrow can block another. Study the layout, spot which arrows are in the way, and find the order that clears the board.
An arrow leaves once its path is open. Tap a blocked one and it counts as a mistake. Every level pays 1 to 3 stars, and fewer mistakes mean more stars. Stars are your score and your building budget. Every star moves the story forward, and the more you earn, the faster you can build. Fail a level and you lose a heart. Early levels teach the rules. Later ones make you think. Hard and super-hard levels put your planning to the test.
💡 Helpers for Tricky Grids
A tight grid doesn't have to stop you. Four helpers are ready: Hint, Eraser, Magic Wand, and Full Grid Zoom.
✨ Why Choose Arrow Story: Home Design
• ⭐ Arrow puzzles with a real payoff: every grid you clear pays stars
• 🔨 Builds you can see: every repair brings the place closer to new, and helps someone who needs it
• ☕ No rush: no timer, so you can take all the time you need
• 📴 Offline play: works without Wi-Fi or mobile data
Take a break with Arrow Story: Home Design. Calm a restless mind, fill a few spare minutes, ease the pressure of the day, and enjoy a puzzle without stress. Along the way, you help people, follow their stories, and feel what a little help can do.
If you like arrow puzzles, arrow escape games, and stories about helping others, this one is for you.
Someone is waiting. Download Arrow Story: Home Design now and start helping people who need it.

apps.name: Pink Pour: Water Sort
apps.description:
Welcome to Pink Pour Water Sort, a relaxing water-sort puzzle game built around color sorting and careful pouring.

Your goal is simple: pour colored water between bottles until every bottle contains only one color. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the top layer of water. Water can be poured into an empty bottle or onto water of the same color. Each level presents a different color arrangement, so you need to observe the order of colors, use empty bottles wisely, and plan your moves carefully.

Each completed level unlocks an entry in the in-game CG gallery. These CG entries are collectible 2D game illustrations that serve as level-completion rewards. You can view unlocked illustrations in the gallery. The CG gallery is a reward and collection feature, while the core gameplay remains water sorting and color classification.

Game features:

    Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

    Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

    Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

    Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

    Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

    Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

    Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Goal:
Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

This is a casual puzzle game focused on water sorting and color classification. The in-game CG illustrations are level rewards and collection content.

apps.name: Sea Playground: Ship Sandbox
apps.description:
Sea Playground is a ship sinking sandbox with real physics. Pick one of 12 ships, pick a tool and see what happens: the hull bends, cracks and floods, fire spreads, and the wreck goes all the way down to the seabed. No levels, no timers — just the sea, 12 ships and your curiosity.

SINK SHIPS YOUR WAY
• Summon the kraken: its tentacles grab a ship and pull it down — or break it in two
• Place timer bombs and wait — or place remote bombs and hit Detonate
• Strike an LNG tanker with lightning and watch the chain reaction
• Push one huge wave under a lake freighter and break it in half
• Set sails on fire with the laser, lift a hull with antigravity or blast it with antimatter
• 20 tools in total, including hammer, tornado, terrain, pull, snap and repair

REAL SHIP PHYSICS
Water pours in through every breach, the hull gives way and the sinking ship finds its own way down. Hit the same ship in a different spot and you get a different shipwreck — no two runs end the same.

12 SHIPS
Galleon, ocean liner R.M.S. Titanic, container ship, rescue boat, cruise ship, superyacht, battleship, LNG tanker, car carrier, lake freighter, paddle steamer and crab boat. Four ships are ready from the start; unlock the rest by watching a short ad.

SEA, WEATHER, DAY AND NIGHT
Calm water or waves, day or night. Call a big wave, a storm or a tsunami whenever you like. At night the deck lights glow and every explosion lights up the dark water.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
Restart with one tap and try the next idea. Sink it, patch it up with the repair tool or just watch the storm roll in.

Sea Playground is a ship sinking simulator for everyone who has ever asked “what if…?” Nothing is unsinkable.

apps.name: Wildhorn Gold Slots
apps.description:
Wildhorn Gold Slots is a five-reel video slot built for short, relaxed sessions. Winning symbols are removed, the reels drop new ones in, and every further cascade in the same spin pays at a bigger multiplier - so one spin can keep paying.

Every spin is decided on your device. The game runs completely offline, so you can play on a flight, on the subway or anywhere else with no signal.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Five reels, three rows and 10 fixed paylines on every spin
- Cascading reels: winning symbols explode out, new symbols drop in, and each further cascade in that spin pays at x1, x2, x3 and x5
- The golden horn is wild and substitutes for every other symbol
- Mystery wilds: extra wilds can drop on any base-game spin
- Bonus Stars open the free spins, and you choose how to play them:
  - More Spins: 6 free spins with every win doubled
  - Bigger Multiplier: 3 free spins with every win multiplied by four
  - Mystery Wilds: 4 free spins with extra wilds dropping in
  Three or more Bonus Stars during the feature add more spins
- Gold coins fill the coin meter. When it is full the Coin Chests bonus opens and you pick 4 of 12 chests for credit prizes of up to 2x your total bet each
- Four jackpots - MINI, MINOR, MAJOR and GRAND - can drop on any base-game spin, and the pot values follow your bet
- Double up any base-game win on red or black for x2, or take the x3 and x5 ladder
- Eight bet levels, from a 20-credit minimum to a 2000-credit maximum
- Auto-spin for up to 100 spins, with stop conditions: stop on a bonus, on a win above a chosen multiple, or when the balance drops
- Missions: three goals run at a time and pay extra credits when you complete them
- A level meter that grows with everything you wager
- Built-in paytable, session statistics and a list of your last 12 spins
- Synthesised sound effects with a one-tap mute, animated win highlights, cascade counters and big-win celebrations
- Your credit balance, settings and progress are remembered between sessions
- Portrait-only, single-hand controls and a layout that scales to any phone screen

There is nothing to download after install and no connection is required to play. Credits are for entertainment only: this is a simulated slot machine, no real money is wagered, no real money can be won and no cash prizes are offered. The game is intended for adults aged 18 and over.

Pull the lever, land the horn, and see how far the gold takes you.

apps.name: Street League Football
apps.description:
Arcade American football on a street field, where every catch, tackle and juke comes from physics. Chase a high score in Endless, take the hit in Tackle Alley, and win 1v1 route battles online or against the CPU.

Players' bodies and the ball actually collide, so no two plays look the same. Run up a wall, go up one-handed over a defender, or truck the tackler and keep going.

MODES
- Endless: CPU opponents get tougher every round. Three strikes and you're out. Play offense, defense or both and climb the global leaderboards.
- Tackle Alley: carry the ball through a lane of tacklers, or line up as the defender and stop the runner.
- Route Battle 1 on 1: receiver against corner, eight reps, roles swap every two. Play online multiplayer with quick match or a room code, or take on four CPU difficulties.
- 3 on 3: squads, rush counts and route calls, online or against the CPU. Still being built.
- Practice: kickoff returns, quarterback drills and route work.

FREE TO START
The free download includes the tutorial, Tackle Alley with one tackler, Route Battle 1 on 1 against Rookie and Street CPU opponents, and the replay editor. One Full Game purchase unlocks Endless, 3 on 3, kickoff returns, quarterback and route practice, online play, more Tackle Alley defenders, and Legend and Insane CPU difficulty. No ads and no subscriptions. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

MORE
- Replay editor: rewatch any play from new camera angles in slow motion, then save and export the clip.
- Locker: build your player's body, head, hair, gear, cleats and colors.
- Touch controls built for landscape, with a layout editor to move every button. Controllers work too.
- Cross-platform online matches.

Online play needs an internet connection and uses Epic Online Services. Found a problem? Use the in-game Feedback button.

apps.name: Krakio: Daily Trivia Dive

• Score points for rarity — every point sinks you 10 metres
• Finish all 7 prompts and see your depth
• Share your dive with friends

One dive per day. No multiple choice. No second chances. Just a fast daily trivia quiz that rewards the answer nobody else typed.

WHY PLAY Krakio
• Fresh daily trivia every day
• Open-ended word quiz — type your own answer
• Rarity scoring: rare sinks, obvious floats
• Depth score down to the trench (700 points)
• Same 7 prompts worldwide so you can compare
• Quick sessions — perfect for a coffee break
• Free daily dive forever

If you like daily trivia, word games, brain teasers, and quiz games with a twist, start your dive in Krakio.

Name the rarest answer. Dive deeper.

Independent app. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any other website or brand.

apps.name: GoreBox 27
apps.description:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

apps.name: Sand Out - Drop Puzzle

Enjoy colourful sand, gentle water effects and satisfying clears in a puzzle game built around simple controls and thoughtful moves.

How to play:

• Match each collector with sand of the same colour.
• Fill and clear collectors to free up space.
• Clear the board to move to the next puzzle.

apps.name: UnGodly
apps.description:
UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG where you control every strike, dodge and hero swap in real-time combat. Collect Primals, build your team and fight to save a world being devoured.

The world of Dunmiir is broken. The Devouring consumes what remains, and only the Primals, scarred warriors who wield elemental power, stand between humanity and extinction. This is a mature action RPG built for players who want real action, deep progression and a story with teeth.

REAL-TIME ACTION COMBAT
Every fight is in your hands. Dodge enemy attacks, swap heroes mid-battle, chain ultimates and trigger elemental reactions to break your enemies apart. Combat is fast, heavy and bloody: cut down foes, sever heads and limbs, and earn every victory through skill and timing. If you love hack and slash action games, UnGodly delivers combat with real weight.

COLLECT AND BUILD YOUR PRIMALS
Recruit Primals, warriors shaped by trauma and power, each built for a distinct combat role. Level them up, upgrade gear, unlock awakenings and customize skills to create your own builds. This hero collector RPG rewards experimentation: every Primal opens new team synergies and new ways to play.

A DARK FANTASY WORLD WORTH SAVING
Explore Dunmiir, a shattered fantasy realm ruled by dangerous factions and corrupted gods. Follow a mature story told through cinematic missions, side quests and character-driven role play. Every chapter of this dark fantasy RPG pulls you deeper into a world of blood, betrayal and survival.

BOSSES, EVENTS AND THE NETHERMAW DESCENT
Face brutal bosses that test your mastery of real-time combat. Take on evolving challenges and live events, then push into the Nethermaw Descent and climb the leaderboards to prove your skill.

DEEP RPG PROGRESSION
UnGodly is a true role playing game at its core. Gear, skills, awakenings, story choices and team synergy all feed long-term progression, so every session moves your Primals forward. Play in focused daily sessions or dive in for hours.

BUILT FOR ACTION RPG FANS
If you play role playing games for the combat and the story, and want an action RPG with skill-based fights, a collection of powerful heroes and a dark story worth following, UnGodly is your next game.

Download UnGodly and fight for what remains.

apps.name: Wordeex
apps.description:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES
Play in your own language or try one you’re learning. Each language has a dictionary of 3,000 common words. Some will feel familiar. Others might become new favorites.

ALL GAME CONTENT IS FREE
Earn coins by completing puzzles and spend them on hints to help you outside Academy. Wordeex includes ads and optional in-app purchases for coins, ad removal and bundles. You can also choose to watch a rewarded ad after solving a puzzle to double your coin reward.

Think you’ve cracked it?
Find the hidden words. Use every letter. Solve the Wordeex.

Privacy Policy: https://wordeex.com/privacy/
Terms and Conditions: https://wordeex.com/terms/

apps.name: Angel Spot
apps.description:
Angel Spot: Find the subtle differences hidden by angels in stunning graphics

Tired of the same old spot-the-difference games? Try Angel Spot. It's an HD visual puzzle game that combines relaxation with a mental workout: find carefully hidden subtle differences in exquisite images and dynamic video clips. Train your eyesight and reaction speed while enjoying the fun of spotting differences anytime, anywhere.

Two Modes, Switch Freely
1. Static Image Mode (Casual & Relaxing)
A massive collection of high-definition static levels with no time limits. You can leisurely compare subtle differences in texture, lighting, color, and details. Perfect for relaxing during short breaks and training your eyesight with zero stress.

2. Dynamic Video Mode (Reaction Challenge)
Think static levels are too easy? Start the fast-paced video challenge and catch the fleeting differences in the frames. Test your eyesight and reaction speed. You get 3 free chances daily; watch a short ad to continue when you run out.

Two Ways to Unlock Rewards
Clear levels to unlock exclusive reward videos and make your gaming experience more complete. There are two unlocking methods:

Free: Watch short video ads to unlock reward videos for free.

VIP Privilege: Subscribe to VIP to unlock all reward videos with one click and enjoy a pure, ad-free experience.

Built-in Content Gallery
The in-game gallery automatically saves all unlocked images and reward videos. You can view, categorize, and manage your collections anytime, and even save your favorite materials locally for permanent keeping.

Core Features

Stunning HD Graphics: Every frame is meticulously polished for clear, delicate, and excellent visual experiences.

Bubble Blitz is a bubble popping puzzle where every level gives you a fixed number of shots to clear the board.

Shoot bubbles at matching colors to make them disappear. A single shot can also cut bubbles loose from whatever they’re hanging on, so they drop off the board even if they don’t match your color.

How to Play:

- Aim your shot and release to send a bubble at the board.
- Match bubbles of the same color to clear them.
- Cut a cluster loose from above to drop extra bubbles at once, matching or not.
- Choose between two bubbles before each shot to pick the color you need.
- Clear every bubble on the board to finish the level.

How to get good at Bubble Blitz

Slow down before each move and read the whole board for the biggest cluster instead of grabbing the closest match. A shot that cuts a big group loose from above often clears more than one that only matches a color. Bounce your shot off a wall to reach an angle a straight shot can’t, and pick between your two available bubbles based on what the board actually needs.

Why play this bubble popping puzzle

Bubble Blitz gives you a real shot count behind the color matching instead of an infinite freeplay mode. It’s a bubble popping puzzle with actual levels to finish, built for a quick round on a break or a longer session at the end of the day. Line up your shot, and see how many bubbles come down with it.

apps.name: Numhop: Math Puzzle
apps.description:
Place the tiles. Wire the numbers. Hit every target.

Numhop is a calm math puzzle about numbers that run down a board. Numbers wait at the top, targets sit at the bottom, and every target needs its own number. How it works
Pick the tiles you need, place them on the board and draw wires between them. Each number follows the wires and changes at every tile it passes. Once each target receives the number it asks for, the level is solved. Solve it with fewer tiles and you earn more stars.

Puzzle mechanics
• Operation tiles — add, subtract, multiply or divide the number that passes through
• Splitters — fork a wire so one number can travel to several places
• Wires — link numbers, tiles and targets to build the route
• Star rating — fewer tiles used means more stars for the level
• Multi-answer targets — some targets accept several different numbers, so more than one solution works
• Walls, fractions and negatives — later boards add obstacles and numbers below zero or between whole ones

Made for calm thinking
The game has 33 levels. A short tutorial comes first, then the puzzles get more interesting. There are no timers, so you can think each wire through at your own pace. A wrong move is easy to take back with undo, and if a board leaves you stuck, the game can show the solution.

apps.name: Grab Cat Hospital
apps.description:
Welcome to Grab Cat Hospital, a fun and addictive physics puzzle game where you'll meet strange, unique cats that never seem to stay still!

Your mission is simple: pull the cat to the finish line. But these cats are anything but ordinary! They have unexpected behaviors, funny personalities, and a stubborn attitude. Tap and hold to pull the cat forward, but the moment you let go, it will immediately run back to where it started!

Stay patient, plan your route, and pull the cat through all kinds of obstacles to reach the finish safely. Don't let their unusual looks fool you—these adorable cats are full of surprises!

Every level features a new layout filled with obstacles, traps, and hilarious situations. Observe carefully, master your timing, and find the best way to guide these quirky cats to the finish line.

With simple one-touch controls and satisfying physics-based gameplay, Grab Cat Hospital is easy to play but increasingly challenging to master.

GAME FEATURES

• Tap and hold to pull strange cats forward.
• Release your finger, and the cat runs back!
• Every cat has a unique look and funny reactions.
• Every level brings a brand-new challenge.
• Dodge obstacles and overcome unexpected situations.
• Master your timing and route to reach the finish.
• Simple controls that are easy to learn but hard to master.
• Funny animations and unexpected character reactions.
• Smooth physics-based gameplay.
• Hundreds of unique and challenging levels.

Every level brings a new surprise. Cats can run, bounce, get pulled back, or do things you never expected. Test your reflexes, improve your timing, and figure out the best way to control these unpredictable characters!

No two levels are exactly alike. As you progress, the obstacles become more unpredictable, and the cats become... even stranger!

Whether you love puzzle games, casual games, physics-based challenges, or simply enjoy cats with personalities like no other, Grab Cat Hospital delivers a fun and surprising experience that will keep you coming back for more.

Can you pull all the strange cats to the finish line?

Download Grab Cat Hospital now and discover the most unique cats around!

apps.name: Lil' Guardsman
apps.description:
Enjoy 10% off during the first two weeks after launch!

👋 Hi, I'm Lil! I'm 12 years old, and today I’m on gate guard duty. What’s that? You don’t think it’s appropriate for a kid to decide who should, and shouldn’t enter the kingdom? You don’t think a 12 year old should be able to send people to the dungeon!? You and me both! But my dad left me in charge, so I guess I don’t have a choice. 
Between shady goblins, haughty elves, and sketchiest of all… humans, I have to conduct interrogations, uncover plots, and survive my shift. Approve, deny, or jail, the fate of the city literally rests on my pre-teen shoulders!

⚖️ Lil’ Guardsman is a comedic, fantasy riff on the border control genre. Every visitor who shows up at the guard shed is a real puzzle that will put your deduction skills to the test. The player must choose to follow, or break, the kingdom’s rules to inspect travelers, identify deception, and make strategic choices.

🪄 As Lil, you must use your wits to outsmart the deceptions of a colorful cast of characters. Letting the wrong person in, or incorrectly sending someone straight to the dungeon, can radically change the course of history, unleashing chaos upon the city. Your individual decisions shape an epic story across twelve levels, a wedding, and a war (that you trigger!) 
 
⚙️ GAME FEATURES

• Full Premium Game: Pay once to unlock the entire adventure. No ads, no microtransactions, no virtual currency.

• Border Post Simulation: Over 100 unique characters to meet, interrogate, and decide the fate of, according to evolving security rules.

• Deduction Mechanics: Use an upgradeable arsenal of tools (Truth Spray, Whip, Metal Detector, and more) with limited uses per day (resource management).

• Interrogation System: Choose your dialogue carefully. Confiscate contraband items, call royal advisors to verify information, and make the final choice to Admit, Deny, or Jail.

• Branching Narrative: Your decisions at the castle gates have direct consequences for the main characters, the kingdom of the Sprawl, and the game's ultimate ending.

• Technical Compatibility: Solo experience optimized for touch screens, 100% playable offline (no internet connection required after the initial installation).

🏅 CRITICAL ACCLAIM AND AWARDS (PC VERSION)
Building on its PC success, Lil' Guardsman has been widely praised by critics and has shined in indie festivals:

🏆 IndieCade Festival: Winner of the Best Performance award for its excellent voice cast.

🏆 Game Development World Championship (GDWC): Winner of the prestigious Studio Award and finalist in the Best Adventure Game, Best Music, and Immersive Audio categories.

🏆 Indie Cup: Winner of the Critics' Choice Award.

⭐ Notable Nominations: Nominated for Best Debut Game at the Indie Games Awards, praised for its plot ("Outstanding Story-Rich Game") at the Steam Awards, and nominated in multiple categories at the Canadian Game Awards (including Game of the Year).

apps.name: Clone Drone in the Danger Zone
apps.description:

apps.name: The Roottrees are Dead
apps.description:
INCLUDES A SECOND MYSTERY: ROOTREEMANIA

IT’S THE LATE ’90s

A private jet belonging to the Roottree Corporation has crashed. On board were the three Roottree sisters and their parents—together worth more than a billion dollars.

Under the eccentric wishes of their great-great-grandfather, Elias Roottree, the family fortune must now be divided among every surviving blood relative.

But who is actually related by blood?

That’s where you come in.

SEARCH THE EARLY INTERNET

Use a dial-up-era computer to search archived websites, old newspapers, interviews, advertisements, photographs, books, and other records. Look for names, faces, dates, occupations, and connections.

CROSS-REFERENCE EVERY CLUE

Compare details across different sources. A single discovery may reveal a forgotten relative, expose a hidden relationship, or unlock an entirely new branch of the family.

REBUILD THE FAMILY TREE

Place each person where they belong. Every correct deduction narrows the possibilities—but as the tree grows, the evidence becomes harder to find and the relationships more difficult to prove.

TRUST YOUR REASONING

Read closely, take notes, connect the facts, and decide where to investigate next. Your only tools are an old computer, careful observation, and deductive logic.

FEATURES

• Search a richly detailed recreation of the late-90s internet
• Identify people through photographs, articles, and scattered records
• Cross-reference names, occupations, relationships, and timelines
• Complete and verify an ever-expanding family tree
• Uncover the secrets hidden within the Roottree bloodline

Every correct name brings you closer to the truth—and perhaps to an even greater lie.

Can you complete the Roottree family tree?

apps.name: ChessGame
apps.description:
Learn chess, play chess offline against the computer and solve chess puzzles — all in one app. ChessGame teaches complete beginners how to play chess, then gives you a real chess engine to beat at 6 levels. No ads, no account, no Wi-Fi needed.

♛ LEARN CHESS STEP BY STEP — FROM BEGINNER TO WINNER
Never played before? Start at move one. The Learn course takes you through 21 chapters and 58 chess lessons: how the pieces move, check and checkmate, castling, en passant and pawn promotion, then chess tactics like forks and pins, and the opening principles strong players use. Every lesson has a live chess board with the legal squares highlighted, and every chapter ends with a short test. Get one wrong and ChessGame shows you the right move — like a patient chess coach in your pocket.

♚ PLAY CHESS VS COMPUTER — 6 AI LEVELS
Play chess against the computer from Beginner to Master, or set an exact Elo rating for a custom challenge. The chess AI runs on your phone, so it answers instantly, even in airplane mode. Beginners get an opponent they can beat; experienced players get a strong engine that punishes every mistake. Play white, black or random, ask for a hint when you're stuck, and take back a move.

♞ CHESS PUZZLES & TACTICS TRAINER
Train your tactics with a daily puzzle and random puzzles — back-rank mates, forks, pins and other classic checkmate patterns — with instant feedback on every move.

♜ CHESS OPENINGS
Explore 42 named openings, from the Italian Game and Ruy López to the Sicilian Defense, and play each line on a live board to learn the ideas behind the moves.

🏆 DAILY GOALS, STREAKS & BADGES

✨ A CLASSIC CHESS BOARD, BEAUTIFULLY MADE
• Warm wooden classic board with a full-screen mode and one-tap landscape
• 9 board themes and 10 piece sets
• Clear highlights for your selected piece, legal moves and the last move
• Light and dark mode
• Sound and vibration you can switch off

• Statistics from your own games

🌍 31 LANGUAGES
Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Telugu, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and more.

🔒 OFFLINE & PRIVATE
No ads. No sign-in. No tracking. Your games, progress and statistics stay on your device. The game, lessons and puzzles all work offline — perfect for flights, commutes and anywhere without internet.

PERFECT FOR
• Beginners who want to learn how to play chess
• Kids and families learning chess together
• Casual players who want a quick offline chess game
• Club players who want a strong chess computer to practise against
• Anyone who loves strategy board games and brain training

Download ChessGame — learn chess, play chess and get better every day.

apps.name: The Farmer Was Replaced
apps.description:
Program a drone. Automate a farm. Watch your code do the work.

The Farmer Was Replaced is a programming game where your drone does the farming. Write short programs in a simple, Python-like language, press execute, and your drone tills, plants, waters and harvests, with results that depend on your code.

No levels, just continuous progression: farm resources, buy unlocks, solve the next problem. Harvest hay, wood and carrots, merge pumpkins into a giant one, sort cacti, find the best sunflower, feed a dinosaur and hunt for treasure in a hedge maze. Become the most efficient farmer in the world.

A CODE KEYBOARD MADE FOR TOUCH
Every symbol you need on one screen. Brackets and quotes come in pairs. Swipe on any key to move the cursor, hold Shift and swipe to select. Undo, redo, comment and paste have their own row. Choose QWERTY, QWERTZ or AZERTY, with key clicks or vibration. Prefer real keys? Connect a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse for more comfortable coding.

LEARN TO CODE
Loops, variables, functions, lists and more, introduced one at a time. The game gives you the tools, but solving the tasks is up to you, and that can be a real challenge. Already a programmer? Race through the basics, then run a fleet of drones.

THE MINER WAS REPLACED, INCLUDED
Take your drone underground and unlock eight new resources, including coal, quartz, mushrooms and dynamite. Dig up ancient ruins without damaging them, sort mushrooms, grow rice on clay and play Minesweeper without blowing up your drone.

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
Try the game for free. After the trial, you’ll need to unlock the full game with a one-time purchase to keep playing. No ads, no subscriptions.

FEATURES
• A real programming language
• Custom code keyboard and support for Bluetooth keyboards and mice
• Portrait or landscape on phones and tablets
• Megafarm: several drones in parallel
• Simulation mode for fast, reproducible testing
• Unlockable achievements
• Hats. Your drone deserves them.
• 14 languages

apps.name: Printa: 3D Printing Tycoon
apps.description:
One gift changed everything: a 3D printer! Now it's up to you to turn ideas into prints, prints into orders, and orders into coins in your piggy bank.

Printa is a cozy tycoon where a kid builds their own 3D printing business at home — and learns how money works along the way.

HOW IT WORKS
• In the morning you take finished orders to school. In the afternoon you come home with the payment and new requests.
• Choose which orders to take: compare the price with the cost of filament and power before saying yes.
• Plan the print queue so your printers keep working while you study and sleep.
• Calibrate machines, replace worn parts and keep them from breaking at the worst moment.

• Revenue, costs and profit explained with a piggy bank and a cash-flow chart.
• Investing: better machines cost a lot today but earn more tomorrow.
• Depreciation: a used printer is worth less when you sell it.
• Planning: rush orders pay more, but the deadline is tight.

PLENTY TO DO

• 6 printers to buy and upgrade, including multicolor machines with up to 4 colors.
• 3 materials (PLA, PETG and TPU) in 6 colors.

• 8 characters to pick from, with your own name in the game.

FAMILY FRIENDLY
